detail.abstract: Experiencing nature has been linked to a host of benefits for health and well-being. Here, we examine if exposure to nature influences the food choices that may contribute to nature's benefits. Five between-subject experiments (n=39, n=698, n=885, n=1191, and n=913) show that individuals exposed to the natural environment choose healthier foods when compared to those exposed to urban environments or a control condition. Nature’s effects are observed for various foods and beverages, across samples from three countries, and in varied contexts, such as taking a walk in a park (vs. a city street) and looking at photos of nature (vs. urban or control) scenes. These findings provide insights into the relationship between proximity to nature and health.

AI.tldr: 接触自然环境会影响人们的食物选择，使其更倾向于选择健康食品，这一效应在五个实验中得到验证，跨越不同国家、食物类型和情境。
AI.research_question: 接触自然环境是否会影响个体的食物选择？
AI.motivation: 体验自然对健康有益，但自然如何通过影响食物选择来促进健康的机制尚不清楚。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于自然环境对心理和行为影响的理论，特别是自然暴露如何调节决策和偏好。
AI.method: 五个被试间实验设计，总样本量超过3700人，包括实地行走和图片观看两种情境，比较自然、城市和控制条件。
AI.findings: 暴露在自然环境中的个体比暴露在城市环境或控制条件下的个体更倾向于选择健康食物，这一效应在不同国家、食物类型和情境中均稳定存在。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了自然环境影响健康的新机制——通过调节食物选择行为，扩展了自然-健康关系的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为城市规划、公共健康干预和饮食行为改变提供了实证依据，建议增加自然接触以促进健康饮食。

detail.title: Exploring E- Impulse Buying Among Online Shoppers: Online Trust as Mediator Between Web Atmospheric Cues and Online Impulse Buying
detail.abstract: Impulse buying has always been an area of research which marketers like to explore and study. With the surge in internet users and e-commerce, online impulse buying is catching the attention of the market. The study makes an attempt to understand the role of atmospherics in the context of website on online impulse buying. It further delves into how online trust can play a role in this interaction. For the collection of primary data, questionnaires were distributed among online shoppers which was then analyzed using SEM in SmartPLS. The results of the study suggest that online trust mediates the relationship between the atmospheric cues and online impulse buying. This study adds to the existing literature shedding more light on the role of online trust and atmospheric cues. Managers need to pay attention to the website design and content as it can lead to trust and thus, enabling impulse purchases online.

detail.title: Trust-by-Design in Proactive E-Commerce: Human-in-the-Loop Mechanisms to Mitigate Automation Distrust

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that there are no known financial or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the research presented in this paper. The study was conducted independently and reflects the author’s original conceptual and analytical work on human-AI symbiosis in digital commerce.
declarations.ethicsApproval: The study did not involve human subjects, patient data, or personally identifiable information. Therefore, formal ethics approval was not required. All conceptual analyses and model evaluations were conducted using publicly available datasets and simulated interaction frameworks.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors. The study was self-funded by the author as part of an independent research initiative on emerging AI-commerce ecosystems.

detail.abstract: This study advances Trust-by-Design as a core architecture within proactive e-commerce systems, embedding human-in-the-loop (HITL) mechanisms to mitigate automation distrust through UX protocols like draft-state management, explainable interfaces, and undo/rollback functions. Addressing opacity in traditional predictive models that erode user confidence in B2B prosumer contexts, the framework ensures 100% agency via nontransactional drafts and transparent reasoning (e.g., "Mapped from X events"). A 12-month randomized controlled trial (n=1,200 users) in a live B2B platform yields a 1.3-point Likert trust uplift (95% CI: 1.1-1.5, p<0.001), 72.5% draft acceptance rate (vs. 45.3% in controls, p<0.001), 38% reduced time-to-approve, and 12% override rates. Theoretically, it reframes procurement as symbiotic coordination, extending hybrid intelligence by quantifying uplift via surveys and proxies in volatile environments. Practically, it provides scalable SaaS blueprints for SMEs, cutting cognitive costs by $1,200/user/year and boosting retention 44% amid disruptions (e.g., 85% error suppression). Differentiating from opaque patents (e.g., US 9152975B1 lacking reversibility), the non-obvious innovations foster ethical AI, with policy implications for digital governance in high-risk economies.

title: Strategic Licensing and Innovation Incentives in Oligopoly

detail.title: Strategic Licensing and Innovation Incentives in Oligopoly
detail.abstract: This paper analyzes how a research lab should choose the breadth of technology licensing when potential licensees can also innovate. In an oligopoly with endogenous R&D effort, broader licensing spreads cost reductions but weakens incentives to invest. The lab's optimal breadth balances rent extraction and innovation erosion, producing an interior solution. Under nonlinear demand, correlation across firms' R&D outcomes breaks neutrality and depresses aggregate effort. Social welfare is single-peaked in licensing breadth, implying that private licensing is too narrow relative to the social optimum.

AI.tldr: 本研究分析了研究实验室在潜在被许可方也能创新的情况下如何选择技术许可的广度。在寡头垄断和内生研发投入的背景下，更广泛的许可虽然能扩散成本降低效应，但会削弱投资激励。实验室的最优许可广度需要在租金提取和创新侵蚀之间取得平衡，产生一个内部解。在非线性需求下，企业间研发结果的相关性打破了中立性并抑制了总体投入。社会福利在许可广度上呈单峰分布，意味着私人许可相对于社会最优而言过于狭窄。

AI.method: 在寡头垄断市场结构下构建理论模型，分析内生研发投入、非线性需求函数以及企业间研发结果相关性的影响

detail.abstract: Emotional intelligence is a critical yet often overlooked skill for youth leadership. This article examines how three core components of emotional intelligence (self-awareness, empathy, and emotional regulation) enable young leaders to build stronger teams and achieve better outcomes. Drawing on neuroscience research, we explain why adolescence is an optimal period for developing these skills, as the teenage brain undergoes significant development in regions governing emotional processing and social cognition. Evidence from meta-analyses demonstrates that emotional intelligence can be learned and strengthened through deliberate practice, with social-emotional learning interventions showing measurable improvements in academic performance, interpersonal relationships, and leadership effectiveness.

title: Not All Risks are Created Equal: Time Horizons of Political Risk and Debt Contracting
affiliations: New York Institute of Technology and Saint Mary's University - Sobey School of Business

detail.title: Not All Risks are Created Equal: Time Horizons of Political Risk and Debt Contracting
detail.abstract: We examine how the time horizon of political uncertainty shapes the pricing and structure of corporate debt. Using firm-level political risk measures matched with granular bank loan data, we show that lenders differentiate between short-term, event-driven shocks and long-term, structural uncertainty. Short-term political risk significantly increases loan spreads and tightens contractual terms, while long-term risk is largely absorbed through non-price mechanisms such as collateral, covenants, and syndicatio n structure. Leveraging close local elections in a regression discontinuity design, we provide causal evidence that heightened short-term uncertainty raises borrowing costs. Further analyses show that firms can mitigate political exposure through proactive de-riskin g, such as withdrawing from unstable jurisdictions , thereby reducing borrowing costs. Overall, political uncertainty operates as a hidden tax on credit intermediation, distorting capital allocation and slowing productive investment.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了政治不确定性时间维度对企业债务定价和结构的影响。研究发现，贷款机构会区分短期事件驱动型冲击和长期结构性不确定性：短期政治风险显著提高贷款利率并收紧合同条款，而长期风险主要通过非价格机制（如抵押品、契约条款和银团结构）来吸收。
AI.research_question: 政治不确定性的时间维度如何影响企业债务的定价和结构？
AI.motivation: 政治不确定性作为信贷中介的隐性税收，扭曲资本配置并减缓生产性投资，需要深入理解其具体作用机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于政治风险理论、债务契约理论和信息不对称理论，区分短期事件驱动型冲击与长期结构性不确定性对信贷决策的不同影响。
AI.method: 使用企业层面的政治风险度量与银行详细贷款数据匹配，并利用地方选举的回归断点设计提供因果证据。
AI.findings: 短期政治风险显著提高贷款利率并收紧合同条款，长期风险主要通过非价格机制吸收；企业可以通过主动去风险化（如退出不稳定地区）来降低借贷成本。

title: Toward a Theory of Intermediary Asset Pricing
affiliations: Concordia University, Quebec - Department of Finance

detail.title: Toward a Theory of Intermediary Asset Pricing
detail.abstract: This paper contributes to the theory of intermediary asset pricing by developing an equilibrium model in which liquidity providers, who are exposed to market risk, become the marginal investors despite their small relative net worth. These intermediaries must operate with leverage, and their stock holdings and the stock market's conditional risk premium should have a strong positive relation. The latter feedback effect leads to significantly longer average stock allocations by the liquidity providers, which incites them to demand a substantial decline in stock prices. This causes a multiple increase in the volatility and the risk premium of the rates of stock returns. Furthermore, the feedback effect between the liquidity providers' stock allocations and the conditional risk premium leads to a short-term reversal of stock returns and a positive comovement between daily changes of liquidity providers' inventory and daily stock returns. The model also explains the conditional covariance between the aggregate consumption and the stock returns, the volatility of the stock returns, and the conditional Sharpe ratio.

title: Strategic Leadership and HR Practices in Organisations

detail.title: Strategic Leadership and HR Practices in Organisations
detail.abstract: This paper examines how IBM strategically aligned its Human Resource Management (HRM) practices with its broader business objectives to navigate the disruptions caused by the COVID-19 pandemic. The analysis focuses on the strategic adaptation of core HR functions including staffing, training and development, compensation, and performance management to support remote work and maintain operational agility. Framed within Strategic Human Resource Management (SHRM) theory, the study highlights how these practices were integral to sustaining IBM's strategic goals of digital leadership and workforce resilience. Furthermore, the paper explores the critical role of structured change management, detailing the application of Kotter's 8-Step Change Model and Kurt Lewin's 3-Step Change Management Model in guiding the organizational transition. These models provided a phased approach to managing change, from creating urgency and forming a guiding coalition to unfreezing old structures, implementing new work models, and refreezing new norms. Supported by adaptive leadership, the integration of SHRM with these established change management frameworks enabled IBM to mitigate immediate disruptions and build a foundation for long-term organizational agility, offering a replicable model for enterprises in volatile environments.

AI.tldr: IBM通过将人力资源管理实践与战略目标对齐，运用战略人力资源管理和变革管理模型，成功应对疫情冲击，构建了组织敏捷性。

detail.title: Lie to Me: Video-Based Detection of ESG Washing
detail.abstract: Analyzing videos of bank CEOs' environmental, social, and governance (ESG) commitment speeches made available by the United Nations Principles for Responsible Banking program, we construct deception scores for banks across 19 countries that represent a significant portion of total global bank assets. We find that after the commitment, banks with higher deception scores exhibit worse ESG fulfillment, as reflected in their borrowers' ESG incidents, ESG ratings, and emission intensity, as well as the banks' own ESG performance. The results are more pronounced when bank CEOs experience greater pressure to appear ESG-friendly, lack sales experience, possess better internal information, and have greater influence over borrowers. The detection power arises primarily from deception cues in the visual dimension, particularly in the eye area, rather than in the text and audio dimensions. The scores' predictive power is incremental to bank ESG ratings, linguistics-based deception indicators, video trustworthiness scores, and video persuasiveness scores.

AI.tldr: 通过分析银行CEO在联合国负责任银行原则项目中的ESG承诺演讲视频，构建了19个国家银行的欺骗评分。研究发现，承诺后欺骗评分较高的银行ESG履行情况更差，这体现在借款人的ESG事件、ESG评级、排放强度以及银行自身的ESG表现上。欺骗检测主要来自视觉维度（特别是眼部区域）而非文本和音频维度。
AI.research_question: 银行CEO在ESG承诺演讲中的欺骗行为是否能够预测银行后续的ESG履行情况？
AI.motivation: 理解银行在ESG承诺中的真实意图与实际行动之间的差距，以及如何通过行为分析来识别潜在的欺骗行为。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于欺骗检测理论、行为金融学和ESG承诺履行理论，结合多模态分析（视觉、文本、音频）来评估CEO的诚信度。
AI.method: 分析联合国负责任银行原则项目中银行CEO的ESG承诺演讲视频，构建欺骗评分，并检验其与银行后续ESG表现的关系。
AI.findings: 欺骗评分较高的银行在ESG承诺后表现出更差的ESG履行情况；欺骗检测主要来自视觉维度；预测能力独立于现有ESG评级和其他欺骗指标。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了欺骗检测理论在金融领域的应用，提供了基于行为分析的ESG承诺诚信度评估方法。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者、监管机构和利益相关者提供了识别银行ESG承诺真实性的工具，有助于更准确地评估银行的ESG风险。

title: Buying an Influencer with Binding Promises
affiliations: SUNY at Binghamton, Department of Economics and Department of Economics

detail.title: Buying an Influencer with Binding Promises

declarations.funderStatement: University of Maryland, Department of Economics

contentType.other: Forthcoming in Review of Law & Economics

detail.abstract: In addition to campaign promises and clientelistic practices via particularized (nonprogrammatic) benefits to boost their chances of winning an election, politicians may also seek the endorsement of influential members of the society in exchange for benefits provided before the election or conditional on electoral success. As a starting point to analyze such exchanges, we construct a simple full-information contractual bilateral exchange game where particularized benefits are exchanged for an influencer's costly action and derive conditions under which different forms of payment would be used. Using a framed laboratory experiment that exogenously varies the politician's gain from winning and the influencer's impact on the chance of success, we find that the number of exchanges is significantly lower than predicted by a model of purely selfinterested behavior. When exchanges do occur, they overwhelmingly take place with winning-conditional payments. Our results are consistent with a model of inequity aversion, whereby influencers' fairness concerns constrain influence buying, particularly when candidates' gains from winning are high. We argue that knowledge of the politician's potential rents, combined with other-regarding preferences among influencers, may limit influence buying.

AI.tldr: 本文通过实验研究发现，政治影响交易的数量显著低于纯粹自利行为的预测，且交易主要采用获胜条件支付形式。研究结果表明，影响者的公平关切会限制影响力购买，特别是在候选人获胜收益较高时。
AI.research_question: 政治人物如何通过特定利益交换来获取社会影响者的支持，以及不同支付形式在什么条件下会被使用？
AI.motivation: 除了竞选承诺和客户主义实践外，政治人物还可能寻求社会影响者的支持，以换取选举前提供的利益或选举成功为条件的利益。
AI.theoretical_framework: 完全信息契约双边交换博弈理论，以及不平等厌恶模型。
AI.method: 框架化实验室实验，外生变化政治人物的获胜收益和影响者对成功机会的影响。
AI.findings: 交换数量显著低于纯粹自利行为模型的预测；当交换发生时，绝大多数采用获胜条件支付形式；结果与不平等厌恶模型一致，影响者的公平关切会限制影响力购买。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个分析政治影响交换的理论框架，并验证了不平等厌恶模型在解释此类交换行为中的适用性。
AI.practical_contributions: 揭示了政治人物潜在租金的知识与影响者的其他关注偏好相结合可能限制影响力购买，为理解政治影响交易的约束机制提供了实证依据。

title: Enhancing Standard Essential Patents' Enforcement through Litigation: A Case for Judicial Determination over Arbitration
affiliations: City University London, The City Law School and BPP University

detail.title: Enhancing Standard Essential Patents' Enforcement through Litigation: A Case for Judicial Determination over Arbitration
detail.abstract:
This article examines the enforcement of standard essential patents (SEPs), arguing that judicial litigation offers superior outcomes over arbitration for licensing disputes. It situates SEPs disputes at the intersection of patent law, competition, and technical standards, underscoring the complexity arising from multi-jurisdictional enforcement and FRAND (fair, reasonable, and non-discriminatory) licensing obligations. 
The paper contends that key features of litigation—transparent rate-setting, rigorous expert evidence scrutiny, the development of binding precedent, and appellate review—make courts more effective in addressing the technical, economic, and public interest dimensions of SEPs licensing. While alternative forums like arbitration may provide efficiency and confidentiality benefits for simple commercial disputes, they lack robust mechanisms for rate calibration, transparency, precedent creation, and coordinated global relief. The article concludes that public adjudication remains essential for yielding predictable, equitable, and market-beneficial SEP licensing frameworks, while arbitration should play only a supplementary role in such contexts.

AI.tldr: 本文主张在标准必要专利(SEPs)许可纠纷中，司法诉讼比仲裁能产生更优结果，因为诉讼具有透明度、专家证据审查、判例发展和上诉审查等关键优势。
AI.research_question: 在标准必要专利许可纠纷中，司法诉讼是否比仲裁能产生更优的结果？
AI.motivation: 标准必要专利纠纷涉及专利法、竞争法和技术标准的交叉领域，存在多法域执行和FRAND许可义务的复杂性，需要有效的争议解决机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 专利法、竞争法、技术标准理论、FRAND许可原则、争议解决机制比较理论
AI.method: 理论分析和比较研究方法，对比诉讼和仲裁在SEPs许可纠纷中的机制特征和效果
AI.findings: 诉讼在费率设定透明度、专家证据严格审查、判例发展和上诉审查方面具有优势，能更好地处理SEPs许可的技术、经济和公共利益维度；仲裁虽然具有效率和保密性优势，但缺乏健全的费率校准、透明度、判例创建和全球协调救济机制。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了标准必要专利争议解决机制的理论比较，明确了诉讼在复杂SEPs纠纷中的制度优势，为FRAND许可框架的构建提供了理论支撑。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者、法院和企业提供了SEPs争议解决的选择指导，建议在复杂SEPs许可纠纷中优先选择诉讼，仲裁仅作为补充角色，有助于建立可预测、公平和市场有益的SEPs许可框架。

title: Does Urban Local Governance Matter? Evidence from India
affiliations: University of Cincinnati

detail.title: Does Urban Local Governance Matter? Evidence from India
detail.abstract: This paper examines the causal effect of urban local governance on public goods provision in India. We exploit quasi-random variation in multi-threshold criteria utilized for classifying Census Towns (CTs) and focus on settlements near the thresholds that are likely to obtain statutory recognition. Using a fuzzy regression discontinuity design, we instrument for urban local governance to identify the Local Average Treatment Effect (LATE). We document a strong first stage relationship between meeting CT thresholds and statutory recognition. Our results show that obtaining an Urban Local Body (ULB) increases local public good provision: government schools increase by approximately 14 (primary), 8 (middle), and 5 (secondary), healthcare infrastructure expands by 2 hospitals and 3 family welfare centers, and financial access deepens with 15 private banks, 2 cooperative banks, and 2 agricultural credit societies. Community amenities improve modestly with an additional public library, reading room, and cinema hall. Sports infrastructure declines by 5 facilities, consistent with our understanding of reallocation of urban space and investments. Our findings suggest that timely municipalization of emerging urban areas can expand provision of certain public goods, which may improve living standards and economic opportunities in urbanizing economies.

AI.tldr: 本文使用模糊断点回归设计研究印度城市地方治理对公共产品供给的因果效应，发现获得城市地方机构地位能显著增加教育、医疗和金融基础设施，但会减少体育设施。
AI.research_question: 城市地方治理对公共产品供给的因果效应是什么？
AI.motivation: 研究城市化进程中及时设立市政机构对改善公共产品供给的重要性
AI.theoretical_framework: 地方治理理论、公共产品供给理论、城市发展理论
AI.method: 模糊回归断点设计，利用人口普查城镇分类标准的多阈值准随机变异

AI.practical_contributions: 为城市化进程中及时设立市政机构以改善公共产品供给提供了政策依据

title: How Founder Expertise Shapes the Impact of Generative Artificial Intelligence on Digital Ventures
affiliations: Stockholm School of Economics and

detail.title: How Founder Expertise Shapes the Impact of Generative Artificial Intelligence on Digital Ventures
detail.abstract: The rapid diffusion of generative artificial intelligence (GenAI) has substantially lowered the costs of launching and developing digital ventures. GenAI can potentially both enable previously unviable entrepreneurial ideas by lowering resource needs and improve the performance of existing ventures. We explore how founders' technical and managerial expertise shapes GenAI's impact on digital ventures along these dimensions. Exploiting exogenous variation in GenAI usage across venture categories and the timing of its broad availability for software tasks (e.g., GitHub Copilot's public release and subsequent GenAI tools), we find that the number of new venture launches increased and the median time to launch decreased significantly more in categories with relatively high GenAI usage. GenAI's effect on new launches is larger for founders without managerial experience or education, while its effect on venture capital (VC) funding likelihood is stronger for founders with technical experience or education. Overall, our results suggest that GenAI expands access to digital entrepreneurship for founders lacking managerial expertise and enhances venture performance among technical founders.

AI.tldr: 生成式AI降低了数字创业成本，使更多创业想法变得可行并提升现有企业表现。研究发现：高使用率类别的新企业数量增加、启动时间缩短；无管理经验创始人受益于新企业启动，有技术经验创始人更易获得VC投资。
AI.research_question: 创始人的技术和管理专业知识如何影响生成式AI对数字企业的双重影响（使不可行想法可行 vs 提升现有企业表现）？
AI.motivation: 生成式AI快速扩散大幅降低了数字创业成本，可能既能使先前不可行的创业想法变得可行，又能提升现有企业的表现。

AI.method: 利用跨创业类别的生成式AI使用外生变异及其广泛可用时机（如GitHub Copilot发布），进行实证分析

title: Digital Repression and Online Resistance: New Media in Mobilizing the July 2024 Uprising in Bangladesh
affiliations: University of Dhaka

detail.title: Digital Repression and Online Resistance: New Media in Mobilizing the July 2024 Uprising in Bangladesh
detail.abstract: The article aims to explore the impact of new media on the July uprising in Bangladesh in 2024. A large-scale social reform movement in Bangladesh resulted in a political uprising that led to the removal from power of the regime, on August 5, 2024. A significant part of the movement’s acceleration was using social media like Facebook, YouTube, and Telegram as a means of communication.  It was mostly students and youth age groups who initiated and participated in the protests, and they utilized social media to communicate meaningfully. Digital repression like internet shutdowns, account suspension, blocking Facebook pages are imposed by the government to suppress facts and prevent protestors from organizing online and be mobilized. The paper surveyed 398 respondents (n=398) and conducted five in-depth interviews. The paper argues that the use of new media as catalyst in the July uprising, and mainstream media mostly served the purpose in favor of the government in Bangladesh.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了新媒体在2024年孟加拉国七月起义中的催化作用，研究发现社交媒体（如Facebook、YouTube、Telegram）在加速社会改革运动中发挥了关键作用，而主流媒体则主要服务于政府利益。
AI.research_question: 新媒体对2024年孟加拉国七月起义的影响是什么？
AI.motivation: 2024年8月5日孟加拉国发生大规模社会改革运动导致政权更迭，社交媒体在运动加速中发挥了重要作用，学生和青年群体利用社交媒体进行有效沟通，而政府则实施数字压制手段。
AI.theoretical_framework: 新媒体在社会运动中的催化作用理论，数字压制与信息控制理论
AI.method: 对398名受访者进行问卷调查，并进行了5次深度访谈
AI.findings: 社交媒体在七月起义中发挥了催化作用，学生和青年群体是抗议活动的主要发起者和参与者，政府实施了互联网关闭、账号暂停等数字压制手段，主流媒体主要服务于政府利益
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了新媒体在社会运动中作为催化剂的理论理解，丰富了数字压制与信息控制理论的应用案例

detail.abstract: Conflict and extreme scenarios compromise the safety of life through violence, infrastructure failure, lack of access to basic resources, and psychologic tolls. This paper integrates current findings related to the toll of civilian mortality and morbidity, psychologic consequences carried by women and children, and ripple impacts evolving from deterioration in water, food, housing, and medical infrastructure. It presents an integrated strategy based upon connecting warning messages and seeking shelters in a manner that connects to protective activity as well as building family and community social support as a protective factor through enhancing individual capacities using civil-military-humanitarian coordination through a set of unique skills for participants. Evidence related to natural experiments in Ukraine suggests that credible and timely announcements of danger decrease civilian death tolls-although in conjunction with alarm fatigue-practical shelters work related to warning converging emphasizes context-specific standard warning messages related to use of explosive weapons in populated areas. This text is placed in context as a psychologic intervention integrated with logistics in that anxiety, depression, and post-traumatic stress disorders are directly related in terms of outcome as well as interventions related to non-compliance or failure as well as interventions related to medical interventions as a therapeutic objective.

AI.research_question: 如何在冲突和极端情境下通过整合策略减少平民伤亡和心理创伤？

AI.method: 基于乌克兰自然实验的证据，分析预警信息、庇护所和社区支持的有效性。

title: For Fun or Money? A Suno AI Music Creators' Motivations
affiliations: Pangasinan State University

detail.title: For Fun or Money? A Suno AI Music Creators' Motivations
detail.abstract: Generative AI music systems such as Suno significantly lower the technical barrier to music creation, enabling non-musicians and musicians alike to generate full songs from text prompts within seconds. Suno is marketed as a tool that allows "anyone to make music," removing the need for instruments or advanced production skills. However, there is limited empirical evidence on why users actually engage with AI music platforms: primarily for enjoyment or as a potential source of income. This paper presents an exploratory, two-category motivational analysis ("for fun" vs "for money") of 100 comments from a Suno-focused Facebook group, responding to a question about whether members make music just for fun or to earn money. Guided by Self-Determination Theory (SDT), we conducted a simple content analysis of user comments, classifying each response based on the presence of intrinsic (fun, enjoyment, hobby, passion) or extrinsic (money, profit, business, commissions) cues. Results show that 68% of respondents were classified as primarily fun-motivated, while 32% were classified as money-motivated. These findings suggest that, at least in this community, Suno functions more as a leisure-oriented creative tool than a straightforward monetization channel, although a substantial minority clearly explore revenue opportunities. The paper situates these results within broader literature on musical motivation, AI-assisted creativity, and prosumer content platforms, and outlines implications for platform designers and future research on AI-mediated music-making.

AI.tldr: 本文通过分析Suno AI音乐平台用户的100条评论，发现68%用户主要出于乐趣动机使用平台，32%出于赚钱动机，表明该平台更多作为休闲创意工具而非直接变现渠道。
AI.research_question: 用户使用AI音乐平台（如Suno）的主要动机是什么？是为了娱乐还是为了赚钱？
AI.motivation: 生成式AI音乐系统大幅降低了音乐创作的技术门槛，但缺乏关于用户实际使用动机的实证证据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 自我决定理论（Self-Determination Theory, SDT）
AI.method: 对Suno相关Facebook群组中100条用户评论进行探索性内容分析，基于内在动机（乐趣、享受、爱好）和外在动机（金钱、利润、业务）线索进行分类。
AI.findings: 68%的受访者被归类为主要出于乐趣动机，32%被归类为金钱动机。
AI.theory_contributions: 将自我决定理论应用于AI辅助创意平台的情境，深化了对AI音乐创作动机的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为平台设计者提供用户动机洞察，建议将Suno定位为休闲导向的创意工具，同时为少数寻求变现的用户提供支持。

detail.title: The Journal of Prompt-Engineered Philosophy Or: How I Started to Track AI Assistance and Stopped Worrying About Slop

publicationDetails.detailsText:
Mirror of arXiv: 2511.08639
Available at https://arxiv.org/pdf/2511.08639

detail.abstract: Academic publishing increasingly requires authors to disclose AI assistance, yet imposes reputational costs for doing so-especially when such assistance is substantial. This article analyzes that structural contradiction, showing how incentives discourage transparency in precisely the work where it matters most. Traditional venues cannot resolve this tension through policy tweaks alone, as the underlying prestige economy rewards opacity. To address this, the article proposes an alternative publishing infrastructure: a venue outside prestige systems that enforces mandatory disclosure, enables reproduction-based review, and supports ecological validity through detailed documentation. As a demonstration of this approach, the article itself is presented as an example of AIassisted scholarship under reasonably detailed disclosure, with representative prompt logs and modification records included. Rather than taking a position for or against AI-assisted scholarship, the article outlines conditions under which such work can be evaluated on its own terms: through transparent documentation, verification-oriented review, and participation by methodologically committed scholars. While focused on AI, the framework speaks to broader questions about how academic systems handle methodological innovation.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了学术出版中AI辅助披露的结构性矛盾：要求披露但声誉受损，导致透明度激励不足。提出在声望体系外建立强制披露、可复现评审的新出版基础设施，并以本文作为AI辅助研究的示范案例。

detail.title: Why 'Fair Market Valuations' are Inappropirate for Employee-Owned Firms and Partnerships
detail.abstract: The usual formulas for the fair market valuation of a firm at time t include the profits accruing to the shares at time t from the use of wage or salaried labor in the future. But in employee-owned firms or partnerships, the future worker-members or partners are the residual claimants at those future times, so in those cases, the future residuals do not accrue to the current shareholder/residual-claimants. Hence any 'fair market valuation' of an employee-owned firm or partnership that assumes those future residuals accrue to the current shareholder/residualclaimants is inappropriate.

detail.title: Enhanced Fault Detection in the Tennessee Eastman Process Using Mahalanobis Distance Based Maximum Likelihood Estimation
detail.abstract: Process fault detection is crucial for ensuring the reliability and efficiency of complex industrial systems. In this study, we evaluate and benchmark five advanced algorithms, including ensemble learning (Light Gradient Boosting, LGB), deep learning (Long Short-Term Memory, LSTM) neural networks, K-Means Clustering (KMC), Principal Component Analysis (PCA), and Maximum Likelihood Estimation-based Mahalanobis Distance (MLE-MD), for robust process monitoring. Using the Tennessee Eastman Process (TEP) simulation dataset, we conduct exploratory data analysis (EDA), including the use of control charts and statistical tests for Gaussianity. A comparative analysis reveals that the MLE-MD model significantly outperforms the other algorithms in overall fault detection, achieving the highest average fault detection score (74.1%). In contrast, while MLE-MD excelled quantitatively, PCA provided enhanced interpretability by generating "fault signatures" through Q-contribution heatmaps. This work provides valuable quantitative insights for practitioners and researchers, validating MLE-MD as the most effective method among those tested for advancing robust fault detection and diagnosis (FDD) systems in industrial environments.

detail.abstract: The growing adoption of Artificial Intelligence (AI) in Human Resource Management (HRM) has changed the process of recruitment, assessment, promotion, and retention of employees in organizations. On the one hand, AI is associated with efficiency and data-based decision-making opportunities, but, on the other hand, it creates an urgent concern about fairness, inclusiveness, and responsibility. The review is a systematic literature review of the literature published since 2010 and covering 201 studies related to algorithmic fairness in HRM. Results show that the research focus is mainly on recruitment and selection, mostly using natural language processing, machine learning classifier, and chatbots, where gender and racial-related bias is the most common. Functional areas like performance assessment, promotion, retention as well as training received relatively less attention, however they demonstrated very serious challenges associated with transparency, cultural bias and unequal access. Review of mitigation strategies reveals that in-processing methods have the highest adoption, but governance framework and human oversight proves to be points of great importance in ensuring sustainable fairness. In quality evaluation, the methodological rigor is skewed with a significant percentage of studies not being transparent about datasets and fairness measures. The review has identified the necessity of standardized means of evaluation, interdisciplinary work, and fairnessby-design principles to match algorithmic tools with the aims of diversity, equity, and inclusion. Finally, the issue of responsible AI in HRM is that it involves a compromise between efficiency and ethical requirements of technology to ensure fair and inclusive workforce policies.

detail.title: Self-adapting Memetic Optimization with Reinforcement Learning for Multi-objective Aircraft Recovery Problems
detail.abstract: Disruptions in airline operations often cause widespread delays and significant economic losses, necessitating effective recovery strategies. Multi-objective aircraft recovery provides diverse schedules and establishing a solid basis for flight rescheduling, but most existing works overlook airport-level capacity constraints, which are critical for ensuring operational feasibility in real-world scenarios. To fill this gap, we develop a new multi-objective aircraft recovery model that jointly considers both aircraft- and airport-level operational constraints, simultaneously optimizing economic performance and operational efficiency to enhance its practical implementability. To solve this challenging problem, we propose a self-adapting memetic optimization algorithm with reinforcement learning (SAMO-RL) that incorporates problem-specific search strategies and repair mechanisms. First, at the global level, a problem-tailored evolutionary computation algorithm with an elite-preserving crossover (EPX) operator adaptively combines parent solutions based on their multi-objective performance, preserving high-quality genetic segments. Then, at the local search level, five structure-driven improvement local search operators are designed and guided by a reinforcement learning agent to autonomously intensify exploitation around promising solutions while maintaining diversity and feasibility. Finally, global and local search are seamlessly integrated via a priority-tiered repair strategy that restores feasibility under both aircraft- and airport-level constraints with minimal loss of objective value. Extensive experiments on 28 ROADEF Challenge instances show that SAMO-RL consistently outperforms six state-of-the-art multi-objective evolutionary algorithms in hypervolume and inverted generational distance. Ablation studies further validate the individual and combined contributions of these components, demonstrating SAMO-RL’s practical potential for aircraft recovery under real-world constraints.

detail.abstract: Proof of Concept (POC) trials should be designed to inform a drug’s targeted benefit-risk profile and ability to fulfill unmet medical needs, rather than simply achieving statistical significance. Pulkstenis, Patra, & Zhang, 2017 proposed a unified Bayesian framework for decision-making in Proof of Concept (POC) trials to weigh evidence regarding a dual-level Target Product Profile (TPP). To accelerate decision-making while evidence is still emerging from a Phase 2 trial, we generalize this framework by incorporating interim monitoring leveraging predictive probability. An accelerated Go-decision can be achieved to initiate Phase 3 studies earlier if sufficiently promising results are observed, while an early No-Go or wait decision can be made when supporting evidence indictates. Practical guidance for implementing the approach is demonstrated by simulation studies of binary and continuous endpoints.

detail.title: When Climate Models Become Tax Policy: Modeling Bias and Manufactured Certainty

publicationDetails.detailsText: Published in The Opinion Pages, October 29, 2025

detail.abstract:
This paper argues that modern climate policy has become overly dependent on opaque and pessimistically biased climate models, turning scientific uncertainty into fiscal orthodoxy. Lewarne explains that major models—NASA’s GISS, the UK Met Office’s HadGEM, NOAA’s GFDL, and NCAR’s CESM—share three adjustable parameters: climate sensitivity, aerosol offsets, and cloud feedbacks. Each involves subjective judgment, and when tuned toward higher warming assumptions, they generate projections that justify aggressive taxation and regulation. He critiques how such “manufactured certainty” embeds itself in laws, carbon pricing, ESG mandates, and global finance through institutions like the IPCC, ECB, and national stress-testing frameworks.

Using the 2025 U.S. policy rollback and Canada’s contrasting industrial carbon reforms, Lewarne shows how model-based fiscal decisions shape divergent approaches to climate governance. He warns that Europe’s continued reliance on high-sensitivity IPCC scenarios misallocates trillions by treating speculative model outputs as settled fact. Developing nations, he notes, are rebelling against one-size climate conditionality, demanding transparency and context sensitivity.

The paper concludes with a call for open-model governance: public disclosure of model parameters, publication of low-sensitivity and reduced-feedback runs, and recognition that models are tools of hypothesis, not truth. Only through transparency and range disclosure, Lewarne contends, can climate modeling recover scientific integrity and prevent its misuse as a mechanism for taxation and global capital control.

AI.tldr: 本文批评现代气候政策过度依赖不透明且带有悲观偏见的气候模型，将科学不确定性转化为财政正统。作者指出主要气候模型通过调整三个主观参数（气候敏感性、气溶胶抵消和云反馈）来支持激进的税收和监管政策，并呼吁建立开放模型治理机制。
AI.research_question: 气候模型中的主观参数调整如何影响气候政策制定和财政决策？
AI.motivation: 现代气候政策过度依赖不透明的气候模型，这些模型通过调整主观参数产生偏向悲观的预测，进而为激进的税收和监管政策提供依据，可能误导财政决策。
AI.theoretical_framework: 批判性政策分析框架，聚焦模型不确定性、科学治理和政治经济学视角。
AI.method: 案例分析法，比较2025年美国政策回滚和加拿大工业碳改革，分析欧洲IPCC情景依赖和发展中国家对气候条件性的反抗。
AI.findings: 主要气候模型（NASA GISS、UK Met Office HadGEM、NOAA GFDL、NCAR CESM）通过调整气候敏感性、气溶胶抵消和云反馈三个主观参数，产生支持激进政策的高变暖预测；这种"制造确定性"已嵌入法律、碳定价和全球金融体系。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"制造确定性"概念，揭示了气候模型中主观参数调整对政策制定的系统性影响；发展了开放模型治理理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 呼吁建立开放模型治理机制，包括公开模型参数、发布低敏感性情景运行结果，提高模型透明度，防止模型被滥用于税收和全球资本控制目的。

title: Bitcoin Access Vehicles for Institutional Investors: A Comparative Analysis of Strategy Incorporated (MSTR) and Spot Bitcoin ETFs
affiliations: Marquette University

detail.title: Bitcoin Access Vehicles for Institutional Investors: A Comparative Analysis of Strategy Incorporated (MSTR) and Spot Bitcoin ETFs
detail.abstract: This study empirically compares two primary Bitcoin access vehicles for institutional investors: spot Bitcoin exchange-traded funds (ETFs), represented by the iShares Bitcoin Trust (IBIT), and corporate Bitcoin strategies, represented by Strategy Incorporated (MSTR). Using data from January 2024 through November 2025 (459 trading days), we examine valuation efficiency, riskadjusted performance, and portfolio effects across multiple market regimes. MSTR trades at a 32.4% premium to its Bitcoin net asset value of $182.74 per share and exhibits a 1.40 beta to Bitcoin, resulting in higher volatility (96.7% vs. 50.6% for IBIT) and 60% share dilution during the study period. While MSTR achieved stronger Sharpe (1.85 vs. 1.12) and Sortino ratios (2.92 vs. 1.68), Jensen's Alpha analysis indicates unstable performance, +106.4% in the recent period versus +11.8% long-term, implying episodic rather than persistent outperformance. Stress testing reveals asymmetric portfolio behavior: MSTR underperforms IBIT by 2.46% in severe stress conditions while offering only 1.82% additional upside in bull markets. IBIT's 0.99 correlation with Bitcoin confirms efficient tracking and minimal structural complexity. Overall, despite MSTR's exceptional absolute returns (351.2% vs. 121.1%), its valuation premium, dilution effects, embedded leverage, and asymmetric downside exposure make spot Bitcoin ETFs the superior vehicle for fiduciary institutional investors seeking transparent and risk-efficient Bitcoin exposure.

AI.tldr: 本研究比较了机构投资者获取比特币敞口的两种主要方式：现货比特币ETF（以IBIT为代表）和企业比特币策略（以MSTR为代表）。研究发现，尽管MSTR提供更高的绝对回报，但其估值溢价、稀释效应、嵌入式杠杆和不对称下行风险使其不如现货比特币ETF适合寻求透明和风险效率的机构投资者。
AI.research_question: 机构投资者应选择现货比特币ETF还是企业比特币策略来获取比特币敞口？
AI.motivation: 随着比特币被机构投资者广泛接受，需要评估不同投资工具的效率、风险和组合效应，为机构投资决策提供实证依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于资产定价理论、投资组合理论和风险管理理论，比较不同投资工具的估值效率、风险调整后表现和组合效应。
AI.method: 使用2024年1月至2025年11月（459个交易日）的数据，分析估值效率、风险调整后表现（夏普比率、索提诺比率、詹森阿尔法）和压力测试下的组合行为。
AI.findings: MSTR交易价格较比特币净资产价值溢价32.4%，贝塔系数1.40，波动率更高（96.7% vs 50.6%），期间经历60%股权稀释。虽然MSTR的夏普比率（1.85 vs 1.12）和索提诺比率（2.92 vs 1.68）更高，但詹森阿尔法不稳定。压力测试显示MSTR在熊市中表现更差。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了机构投资者比特币敞口工具选择的理论框架，识别了企业策略的嵌入式杠杆和不对称风险特征。
AI.practical_contributions: 为机构投资者提供了实证证据，表明现货比特币ETF在透明度和风险效率方面优于企业策略，有助于投资决策和风险管理。

title: Two Millennia of Chinese Economic Growth
affiliations: Renmin University of China - School of Agricultural Economics and Rural Development and Renmin University of China - School of Agricultural Economics and Rural Development

detail.title: Two Millennia of Chinese Economic Growth

publicationDetails.journalName: Centre for Quantitative History Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: We construct a continuous decadal GDP dataset for China spanning 220 BCE to 1949 CE. Over more than two millennia, China’s economic trajectory exhibits a millennial-scale inverted U-shape: GDP per capita (1990 international dollars) rose from 380 in 220 BCE to a peak of 1,430 in 1000 CE, then entered a period of fluctuating decline after the Northern Song, stabilizing at around 550 by the early twentieth century. Our empirical analysis indicates that China’s long-run economic growth followed a Malthusian pattern. The key difference between the first and second millennia lies in the emergence of severe land–population pressures during the latter, coupled with weak performance in human capital accumulation and technological progress. Chinese history demonstrates that long-term economic growth has been fundamentally knowledge-driven.

AI.tldr: 该研究构建了公元前220年至1949年中国连续十年GDP数据集，发现中国经济在两千多年间呈现倒U型轨迹：人均GDP从公元前220年的380美元上升到公元1000年的1430美元峰值，然后波动下降至20世纪初的550美元。实证分析表明中国长期经济增长遵循马尔萨斯模式，第二千年的关键差异在于土地-人口压力加剧，人力资本积累和技术进步表现疲弱。
AI.research_question: 中国从公元前220年到1949年的长期经济增长模式是什么？
AI.motivation: 构建连续的历史GDP数据集，分析中国两千多年经济发展的长期轨迹和驱动因素。
AI.theoretical_framework: 马尔萨斯增长理论，强调人口压力对经济增长的制约作用。
AI.method: 构建连续十年GDP数据集，进行实证分析。
AI.findings: 中国经济呈现千年尺度的倒U型轨迹，人均GDP在公元1000年达到峰值后波动下降；长期增长遵循马尔萨斯模式，第二千年出现严重的土地-人口压力，人力资本和技术进步表现疲弱。
AI.theory_contributions: 验证了马尔萨斯理论在中国长期历史发展中的适用性，揭示了知识驱动型经济增长的重要性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解中国长期经济发展模式提供了实证基础，对现代经济发展政策具有启示意义。

title: Regulation and Responsible Innovation
affiliations: Pontificia Universidad Catolica de Chile, Universidad Andrés Bello and

detail.title: Regulation and Responsible Innovation
detail.abstract: Should product harms be investigated by firms via 'Responsible Innovation' (RI) or by regulators? Firms can investigate potential harms early on, but only by diverting resources from innovation. Regulators, by contrast, often investigate harms after products are on the market. We characterize the efficient solution, which hinges on the firm's opportunity cost of RI-how sensitive innovation success is to resource diversion-and the regulator's cost of investigating harms. Our main insights are threefold. First, efficiency assigns primary responsibility to the lowest-cost party: firms when innovation success is insensitive to resource diversion, regulators when innovation success is highly sensitive. Second, efficient regulatory actions can be implemented with standard tools-fines, bans, and investigations-but this hinders firms' RI incentives. Third, competition reduces RI investments for each firm but can raise aggregate RI. Our results highlight the trade-off between efficient oversight and incentives for responsible innovation while cautioning against one-size-fits-all regulation.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了产品危害应由企业通过'负责任创新'(RI)还是由监管机构来调查的问题。研究发现，效率最高的解决方案取决于企业RI的机会成本（创新成功对资源转移的敏感度）和监管机构的调查成本。主要结论包括：效率原则将主要责任分配给成本最低的一方；标准监管工具会削弱企业RI激励；竞争会减少单个企业的RI投资但可能提高总体RI水平。
AI.research_question: 产品危害应该由企业通过'负责任创新'(RI)还是由监管机构来调查？
AI.motivation: 企业可以在早期调查潜在危害，但需要从创新中转移资源；监管机构通常在产品上市后调查危害。需要理解在什么条件下由哪一方调查更有效率。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于成本效益分析框架，考虑企业RI的机会成本和监管机构的调查成本
AI.method: 理论建模分析，构建效率最优解模型
AI.findings: 1. 效率原则将主要责任分配给成本最低的一方：当创新成功对资源转移不敏感时由企业负责，当高度敏感时由监管机构负责；2. 标准监管工具（罚款、禁令、调查）会削弱企业RI激励；3. 竞争减少单个企业RI投资但可能提高总体RI水平
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个分析产品危害调查责任分配的框架，揭示了效率与激励之间的权衡关系
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了指导：避免一刀切的监管，应根据具体情况分配调查责任；提醒监管者注意标准工具对RI激励的负面影响

title: Between Retail and Wholesale: Organized Crime in Rio de Janeiro and São Paulo as a Parallel State
affiliations: Independent Researcher and

detail.title: Between Retail and Wholesale: Organized Crime in Rio de Janeiro and São Paulo as a Parallel State
detail.abstract: Organized crime in Brazil has evolved from a mere criminal phenomenon into a consolidated economic, political, and social actor. This article analyzes the distinct and complementary operational models of factions in Rio de Janeiro and São Paulo, highlighting their parallel economies and their impacts on society, the economy, and politics. The research indicates that these groups not only control territories but also provide services, generate employment, and impose social norms, functioning as veritable parallel states. Based on official data (IBGE, IPEA, Atlas of Violence), investigative reports, expert interviews, and empirical observations in peripheral communities, this study seeks to understand how these organizations structure a multi-billion-dollar parallel GDP, engaging with both illicit markets and the formal dynamics of the economy. The analysis also dialogues with the concepts of the economics of crime and the social economy of the base of the pyramid, demonstrating how a significant portion of the peripheral population is integrated into systems of credit, consumption, and survival shaped by these organizations. By examining the cases of the Comando Vermelho (CV) and the Primeiro Comando da Capital (PCC), the article demonstrates that such groups have transcended common crime, becoming complex organizations with the capacity to influence elections, negotiate with the state, shape popular culture, and impact Brazilian democracy itself.

AI.tldr: 巴西有组织犯罪已从单纯的犯罪现象演变为经济、政治和社会行为体。本文分析里约热内卢和圣保罗派系的运营模式，揭示其平行经济对社会、经济和政治的影响。研究表明这些组织不仅控制领土，还提供服务、创造就业、制定社会规范，成为真正的平行国家。
AI.research_question: 巴西有组织犯罪组织如何构建数十亿美元的平行GDP，并影响社会、经济和政治领域？
AI.motivation: 理解有组织犯罪如何从犯罪现象演变为经济、政治和社会行为体，以及其对巴西民主的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 犯罪经济学、金字塔底层社会经济、平行国家理论
AI.method: 基于官方数据（IBGE、IPEA、暴力地图）、调查报告、专家访谈和边缘社区实证观察的混合研究方法
AI.findings: CV和PCC等组织已超越普通犯罪，成为能够影响选举、与国家谈判、塑造流行文化并影响巴西民主的复杂组织；这些组织构建了数十亿美元的平行经济，将边缘人口整合到由其塑造的信贷、消费和生存系统中
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了犯罪经济学和金字塔底层社会经济理论，提出了有组织犯罪作为平行国家的分析框架
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供理解有组织犯罪复杂性的新视角，有助于制定更有效的公共安全和社会政策

title: From Vulnerability to Resilience: The Impact of Global Shocks on Recovery Pathways in Tourism-Dependent Economies
affiliations: Indian Institute of Science (IISc) - Department of Materials Engineering, affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: From Vulnerability to Resilience: The Impact of Global Shocks on Recovery Pathways in Tourism-Dependent Economies
detail.abstract: Tourism-dependent economies are among the most exposed to global shocks, facing acute disruptions from crises such as pandemics, financial downturns, and climate-related disasters. This article examines how vulnerability is manifested and how resilience is constructed in the recovery pathways of states whose prosperity relies heavily on international tourism. Drawing on empirical evidence from small island developing states and selected emerging destinations, the analysis highlights three interrelated dimensions: structural dependence on external markets, the adaptability of tourism infrastructure, and the flexibility of labor markets. The findings demonstrate that while shocks generate severe short-term losses in arrivals, revenues, and employment, they also create opportunities for institutional innovation, diversification, and sustainabilityoriented reforms. Recovery trajectories vary across cases, shaped by governance capacity, regional cooperation, and access to international finance. The study underscores the dual nature of tourism dependency-as a source of fragility and as a platform for resilience-building. It concludes that policies integrating crisis preparedness, investment in adaptive infrastructure, and inclusive labor strategies are critical to transforming vulnerability into resilience in tourism-dependent economies.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了依赖旅游业的脆弱经济体如何从全球冲击中恢复，发现旅游依赖既是脆弱性来源也是韧性建设平台，强调了整合危机准备、适应性基础设施投资和包容性劳动力政策的重要性。
AI.research_question: 依赖国际旅游业的脆弱经济体如何表现其脆弱性，以及在复苏路径中如何构建韧性？
AI.motivation: 依赖旅游的经济体最容易受到全球冲击的影响，面临疫情、金融危机和气候灾害等危机的严重破坏。
AI.theoretical_framework: 脆弱性与韧性理论，重点关注结构性依赖、基础设施适应性和劳动力市场灵活性三个相互关联的维度。
AI.method: 基于小岛屿发展中国家和新兴目的地的实证证据进行分析。
AI.findings: 冲击虽然造成短期损失，但也创造了制度创新、多元化和可持续性改革的机会；复苏轨迹因治理能力、区域合作和国际融资渠道而异。
AI.theory_contributions: 阐明了旅游依赖的双重性质——既是脆弱性来源，也是韧性建设平台。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出了整合危机准备、适应性基础设施投资和包容性劳动力政策的政策建议，以将脆弱性转化为韧性。

title: Value Premium: Evaluating Long-Term Returns Based on Value Investing Indicators Compared to Benchmarks
affiliations: , Mackenzie Presbyterian University, Mackenzie Presbyterian University and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Value Premium: Evaluating Long-Term Returns Based on Value Investing Indicators Compared to Benchmarks
detail.abstract: This research evaluated the long-term returns of annually rebalanced portfolios in the Brazilian equity market from 2013 to 2023, constructed using Graham’s defensive-investor criteria: a P/E × P/B product ≤ 22.5, current ratio > 2, liabilities < shareholders equity, and minimum liquidity. Portfolios were benchmarked against BOVA11 (market index) and IMA-S (t-bonds index). Over ten annual periods, nine portfolios outperformed both benchmarks, delivering a cumulative return of 152.48% versus 87.57% (BOVA11) and 63.66% (IMA-S); Student’s t-tests and Paired Wilcoxon signed‑rank tests confirm these differences are statistically significant. Excluding the extreme outlier PRIO3—which alone would have generated 384.41%—made the results more robust. Eight portfolios achieved higher Sharpe ratios than BOVA11, indicating superior risk-adjusted performance. However, portfolio sizes fluctuated between 3 and 23 stocks, with three years holding fewer than ten names—most notably during the COVID-19 period—raising unsystematic risk. To address concentration, we propose adaptively relaxing selection thresholds in restrictive environments to broaden the universe. Finally, historical sensitivity and stress-scenario analyses demonstrate the strategy’s resilience under pessimistic market conditions, outperforming alternative market conditions.

AI.tldr: 本研究评估了2013-2023年巴西股市中采用格雷厄姆防御型投资者标准构建的年度再平衡投资组合的长期回报。结果显示，9个投资组合中有8个跑赢市场指数和国债指数，累计回报率达152.48%，且风险调整后表现更优，但存在投资组合规模波动和集中度风险问题。
AI.research_question: 采用格雷厄姆防御型投资者标准构建的年度再平衡投资组合在巴西股市中的长期表现如何？
AI.motivation: 评估价值投资策略在巴西新兴市场中的有效性，为投资者提供基于经典投资理论的实证证据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于本杰明·格雷厄姆的防御型投资者理论框架，包括P/E×P/B乘积≤22.5、流动比率>2、负债<股东权益等筛选标准。
AI.method: 采用回溯测试方法，构建年度再平衡投资组合，并与BOVA11市场指数和IMA-S国债指数进行对比分析，使用t检验和Wilcoxon符号秩检验验证统计显著性。
AI.findings: 10年期间9个投资组合跑赢基准，累计回报152.48% vs 87.57%(BOVA11)和63.66%(IMA-S)，8个投资组合夏普比率更高，但存在投资组合规模波动问题。
AI.theory_contributions: 验证了格雷厄姆投资理论在新兴市场的适用性，为价值投资策略提供了实证支持。
AI.practical_contributions: 为巴西市场投资者提供了可行的防御型投资策略，并提出适应性阈值调整方法以应对集中度风险。

title: Risk Factor Similarity and Economic Links
affiliations: Shanghai International Studies University and Central South University

detail.title: Risk Factor Similarity and Economic Links
detail.abstract: Identifying new economic links between firms is challenging. We address this issue by studying the similarity in firms' risk factor disclosures, which captures a wide range of risk-based firm linkages. We find evidence of return predictability among firms with high similarity in risk factor disclosure (risk peers). This link subsumes several well-documented cross-firm momentum patterns, and uncovers links not captured by existing measures. The effects are stronger when: (i) focal firms receive less attention or have higher limits to arbitrage; (ii) risk peers are not in the same industry; (iii) there are changes in the risk factor disclosure. The predictability extends to the options market, revealing similar patterns in higherorder moments. Overall, similarity in risk disclosures offers a broad and informative perspective on firm-level economic links and their implications for cross-stock return predictability.

AI.tldr: 本文研究发现，基于风险因子披露相似性的公司关联能够预测股票回报，这种关联超越了传统行业分类，并在期权市场中同样适用。
AI.research_question: 风险因子披露相似性是否能够识别公司间的经济关联，并预测跨股票回报？
AI.motivation: 识别公司间新的经济联系具有挑战性，现有方法可能无法捕捉到所有重要的关联。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于信息不对称理论和行为金融学，风险披露相似性反映了公司间潜在的经济联系。
AI.method: 使用文本分析方法衡量公司风险因子披露的相似性，构建风险同伴组合，并进行投资组合分析和回归检验。
AI.findings: 风险同伴之间存在显著的回报可预测性，这种关联超越了行业分类，并在期权市场中同样存在。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了基于风险披露相似性的新公司关联度量方法，丰富了公司间经济联系的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者提供了新的投资策略视角，帮助识别被忽视的公司关联和套利机会。

title: Commitment, Resale, and Platform Design in Durable Digital Goods Markets
affiliations: University of Alabama

detail.title: Commitment, Resale, and Platform Design in Durable Digital Goods Markets
detail.abstract: We study resale and commitment in markets for durable digital goods. A monopolistic platform sells digital copies that can be resold subject to a commission. With commitment, resale creates an option value that flattens demand, lowers prices, and raises consumer surplus; without commitment, the platform undercuts resale and the secondary market unravels. Extensions with population entry and multiperiod dynamics confirm the robustness of these results. Allowing behavioral biases-myopia, present bias, and misperceived ownership-explains why consumers overpay for nontransferable licenses. Policy instruments such as commissions, bundling, buybacks, and disclosure rules jointly determine when digital resale is sustainable and welfare-enhancing.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了数字耐用品的转售和承诺问题。研究发现，在平台有承诺的情况下，转售创造了期权价值，降低了价格并提高了消费者剩余；但在无承诺时，平台会削弱转售市场。行为偏差解释了消费者为何为不可转让许可证支付过高价格。政策工具共同决定了数字转售的可持续性和福利效应。
AI.research_question: 数字耐用品市场中转售和承诺如何影响市场结果？
AI.motivation: 研究数字耐用品转售市场的运作机制，以及平台承诺对转售市场稳定性的影响，为政策制定提供理论依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 垄断平台定价理论、耐用消费品理论、行为经济学（短视、现时偏差、所有权误判）
AI.method: 理论建模分析，包括基础模型和扩展模型（人口进入、多期动态、行为偏差）
AI.findings: 有承诺时转售创造期权价值，降低价格并提高消费者剩余；无承诺时平台会削弱转售市场；行为偏差解释了消费者对不可转让许可证的过高支付意愿
AI.theory_contributions: 建立了数字耐用品转售的理论框架，揭示了承诺在转售市场中的关键作用，整合了行为经济学解释
AI.practical_contributions: 为平台设计转售机制提供指导，为政策制定者提供佣金、捆绑、回购和披露规则等工具的设计建议

title: Push-Response Anomalies in High-Frequency S&P 500 Price Series
affiliations: Columbia University and

detail.title: Push-Response Anomalies in High-Frequency S&P 500 Price Series
detail.abstract: We test the hypothesis that consecutive intraday price changes in the most liquid U.S. equity ETF (SPY) are conditionally nonrandom. Using NBBO event-time data for about 1,500 regular trading days, we form for every lag L ordered pairs of a backward price increment ("push") and a forward price increment ("response"), standardize them, and estimate the expected responses on a fine grid of push magnitudes. The resulting lag-by-magnitude maps reveal a persistent structural shift: for short lags (1-5,000 ticks), expected responses cluster near zero across most push magnitudes, suggesting high short-term efficiency; beyond that range pronounced tails emerge, indicating that larger historical pushes increasingly correlate with nonzero conditional responses, in defiance of random behavior. We also find that large negative pushes are followed by stronger positive responses than equally large positive pushes, which is consistent with asymmetric liquidity replenishment after sell-side shocks. Decomposition into symmetric and antisymmetric components and the associated dominance curves confirm that short-horizon efficiency is restored only partially. The evidence points to an intraday, lag-resolved anomaly that is invisible in unconditional returns and that can be used to define tradable pockets and risk controls.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过分析SPY ETF的高频数据发现，在短滞后（1-5,000个tick）内价格变化接近随机，但在更长滞后区间内，较大的历史价格变动会显著影响未来价格变化，表现出非随机性。特别是大额负向价格变动后会出现更强的正向响应，表明卖盘冲击后的流动性恢复具有不对称性。
AI.research_question: 美国最具流动性股票ETF（SPY）的连续日内价格变化是否具有条件非随机性？
AI.motivation: 检验市场效率理论，探索高频交易环境下价格行为的微观结构特征，识别传统无条件收益分析无法发现的日内异常模式。
AI.theoretical_framework: 市场效率理论、价格发现理论、流动性理论、微观结构理论
AI.method: 使用约1,500个正常交易日的NBBO事件时间数据，构建滞后L的有序价格变动对（"推动"和"响应"），标准化后估计在推动幅度细网格上的期望响应。
AI.findings: 1）短滞后区间（1-5,000个tick）内预期响应接近零，表明短期高效性；2）长滞后区间出现明显尾部效应，大历史推动与条件非零响应相关；3）大负向推动后的正向响应强于同等规模的正向推动，表明流动性恢复不对称。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了传统无条件收益分析无法发现的日内滞后解析异常，挑战了随机游走假说，深化了对市场微观效率的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为定义可交易机会和风险控制提供了实证基础，有助于高频交易策略开发和风险管理。

title: An Investigation of Brain Drain/Gain in Atlantic Canada (2011-21) Using a Revised Index and Probit Model
affiliations: University of New South Wales (UNSW)

detail.title: An Investigation of Brain Drain/Gain in Atlantic Canada (2011-21) Using a Revised Index and Probit Model
detail.abstract: Brain drain or gain, through changes in the stock of human capital, can affect the productivity and economic growth of a region. However, precisely determining whether a province inside a country has experienced brain drain or gain during a period can be challenging since it depends on the net flow, both inflow and outflow, of skilled workers. This study utilizes a revised Brain Drain/Gain Index (BGDI*) to investigate brain drain/gain in Atlantic provinces and compare their situation to other provinces in Canada. The BGDI*s, calculated using the Canadian National Household Survey (2011), Census 2016 and 2021, and Postsecondary Student Information System (PSIS) data, indicate that most of the Atlantic provinces experienced brain drain during 2011-16 and brain gain during 2016-21. Estimation from a probit model reveals that recent immigrants, more educated individuals, higher income groups, and ethnic minorities have a higher tendency to move out of the Atlantic provinces.

AI.tldr: 本研究使用修订版脑力流失/获得指数(BGDI*)分析加拿大各省脑力流动情况，发现大西洋省份在2011-16年间经历脑力流失，2016-21年间转为脑力获得。
AI.research_question: 加拿大各省特别是大西洋省份是否经历了脑力流失或获得？哪些因素影响人口流动？
AI.motivation: 脑力流动通过改变人力资本存量影响地区生产力和经济增长，但准确确定省份层面的脑力流动状况具有挑战性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 脑力流失/获得理论、人力资本理论、区域经济发展理论
AI.method: 使用修订版脑力流失/获得指数(BGDI*)，基于加拿大国家家庭调查(2011)、人口普查(2016和2021)和高等教育学生信息系统数据，并采用probit模型进行估计
AI.findings: 大西洋省份在2011-16年间经历脑力流失，2016-21年间转为脑力获得；新移民、高学历者、高收入群体和少数族裔更倾向于离开大西洋省份
AI.theory_contributions: 提出修订版脑力流动指数，丰富脑力流动测量方法，深化对区域人力资本流动机制的理解
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供脑力流动监测工具，帮助制定人才吸引和保留政策，促进区域均衡发展

title: Geopolitics and Export Miracles: Firm-Level Evidence from U.S. War Procurement in Korea
affiliations: London School of Economics and Political Science, Independent, Nathaniel Lane and University of Oxford, Saïd Business School

detail.title: Geopolitics and Export Miracles: Firm-Level Evidence from U.S. War Procurement in Korea
detail.abstract: How did geopolitics shape East Asia's economic development? We show that U.S. war procurement during the Vietnam War-a shock equivalent to 2.9% of South Korea's GDP, rivaling the Marshall Plan-catalyzed the country's export-led industrialization. We construct a new firm-level dataset linking Korean export records with U.S. procurement contracts (1966-1974) to estimate the causal impact of winning a contract on export performance. Winning an initial contract increases a firm's likelihood of exporting by 46 percentage points and triples its export value. These effects extend beyond sales to the United States: treated firms also expanded into third-country markets. We validate our research design using unique, contemporaneous firm-level export targets, showing that contracts were not anticipated and unrelated to export shocks. The policy had lasting effects. We find that firms treated in the 1960s responded more strongly to South Korea's heavy and chemical industry drive of the 1970s, indicating that U.S. procurement and domestic industrial policy were complementary. Our findings reveal a neglected channel through which Cold War geopolitics helped shape the East Asian economic miracle.

AI.tldr: 美国在越南战争期间的军事采购（相当于韩国GDP的2.9%）催化了韩国的出口导向型工业化。获得美国合同的企业出口可能性增加46个百分点，出口值增长三倍，且效应扩展到第三方市场。这些企业后来对韩国重化工业政策反应更强，表明美国采购与国内产业政策具有互补性。
AI.research_question: 地缘政治如何塑造东亚经济发展？越南战争期间美国军事采购对韩国出口导向工业化的影响
AI.motivation: 揭示冷战地缘政治在塑造东亚经济奇迹中被忽视的渠道，特别是美国战争采购作为催化剂的作用
AI.theoretical_framework: 地缘政治经济学、出口导向工业化理论、产业政策互补性理论
AI.method: 构建新的企业层面数据集，将韩国出口记录与美国采购合同（1966-1974）关联，使用因果推断方法估计合同对出口表现的影响，并利用企业层面出口目标验证研究设计
AI.findings: 获得初始合同使企业出口可能性增加46个百分点，出口值增长三倍；效应扩展到第三方市场；合同未被预期且与出口冲击无关；1960年代获得合同的企业对1970年代重化工业政策反应更强
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了冷战地缘政治通过战争采购渠道影响经济发展的机制，证明了外部冲击与国内产业政策的互补性
AI.practical_contributions: 为发展中国家理解外部机遇与国内政策的协同作用提供启示，对后发国家工业化战略具有参考价值

title: Looking at the Bigger Picture: How Abstracting Information Can Help Solve Epistemic Problems in Games
affiliations: Tel Aviv University

detail.title: Looking at the Bigger Picture: How Abstracting Information Can Help Solve Epistemic Problems in Games
detail.abstract: In this paper, players participate in a game whose outcome is determined by their choices based on what they learn during the game. However, the players' sensitivity to details is the product of a social norm. Termed the I-equilibrium, the solution to this collective epistemic problem is a filter-an abstraction of the players' information-whose effect on the outcome of the underlying game is unanimously preferred by all players. The proposed framework alludes to how agents might coordinate in complex environments by adopting a less detailed representation of their surroundings, with an example drawn from Rubinstein's (1989) electronic mail game demonstrating the conditions for successful coordination.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了I-均衡概念，解决玩家在基于社会规范形成的信息敏感度下的集体认知问题。通过信息过滤器抽象玩家信息，使所有玩家一致偏好对基础博弈结果的影响，并以Rubinstein电子邮件游戏为例说明在复杂环境中通过简化环境表征实现协调的条件。
AI.research_question: 玩家如何在社会规范决定的信息敏感度下，通过集体认知协调解决博弈问题？
AI.motivation: 研究在复杂环境中，玩家基于社会规范形成的信息敏感度如何影响他们的决策和协调能力。
AI.theoretical_framework: I-均衡理论、集体认知问题、信息过滤器概念、社会规范与信息敏感度的关系
AI.method: 理论框架构建，以Rubinstein(1989)电子邮件游戏为例进行概念验证
AI.findings: I-均衡作为解决方案，通过信息过滤器抽象玩家信息，能够产生所有玩家一致偏好的博弈结果，在复杂环境中通过简化环境表征实现成功协调。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了I-均衡概念，发展了集体认知问题的理论框架，将社会规范与信息敏感度纳入博弈分析。
AI.practical_contributions: 为复杂环境中的协调问题提供了理论指导，展示了通过简化环境表征实现成功协调的可行条件。

title: New Climate Scenarios Highlight Short-Term Financial and Macro-Economic Risks
affiliations: Université Paris I Panthéon-Sorbonne, Climate Finance Alpha, affiliation not provided to SSRN, Utrecht University, International Institute for Applied Systems Analysis (IIASA), University of Zurich - Department Finance, E3Modelling S.A., Ca Foscari University of Venice, International Institute for Applied Systems Analysis (IIASA), University of São Paulo (USP), affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, Vienna University of Economics and Business, affiliation not provided to SSRN and Reserve Bank of Australia

detail.title: New Climate Scenarios Highlight Short-Term Financial and Macro-Economic Risks

declarations.funderStatement: This research received funding form the CLIMATE WORKS foundation and form the EU Horizon Europe Programme through project DECIPHER (grant agreement ID: 288028).

detail.abstract: Climate change is increasingly understood not only as an environmental challenge but also as a potential source of instability in the global financial system. Disruptions arising from a too late and sudden transition to a low-carbon economy and from the physical impacts of climate change have become financially material risks at a short-term horizon. However, a quantitative framework to assess the short-term financial and macroeconomic implications of climate risks is missing. Existing integrated assessment models (IAMs) have a long-term focus, lack the granularity fit for financial risk assessment, neglect the role of expectations and of feedback loops between the real and financial spheres, and often overlook the correlated and compounding nature of risks. Here we develop an integrated modelling framework that bridges climate impacts, macroeconomics and financial risk to assess how climate-related shocks could impact asset values and propagate through the real-financial interface. Working closely with a network of international regulators, we analyse climate scenarios that reflect both policy-driven transitions and evolving physical risks. We find substantial scenariocontingent impacts on short-term economic and financial risks. The risk of sovereign default increases over a percentage point in most countries and up to thirty percentage points in certain sectors. When the feedback ejects of these financial impacts on macroeconomic dynamics are factored in, we find that estimates of GDP losses are amplified by a third on average and up to a factor of two for certain regions and scenarios, including China and the US in the most adverse physical risk scenarios.

AI.tldr: 本文开发了一个整合气候影响、宏观经济和金融风险的建模框架，用于评估气候相关冲击如何影响资产价值并通过实体-金融接口传播。研究发现气候风险会显著增加主权违约风险，并使GDP损失估计值平均放大三分之一。
AI.research_question: 如何量化评估气候风险对短期金融和宏观经济的影响？
AI.motivation: 气候变化不仅是环境挑战，也是全球金融体系不稳定的潜在来源。现有的综合评估模型(IAMs)具有长期焦点，缺乏适合金融风险评估的粒度，忽视了预期的作用以及实体与金融领域之间的反馈循环。
AI.theoretical_framework: 整合气候影响、宏观经济和金融风险的建模框架，强调实体与金融领域之间的反馈循环。
AI.method: 与国际监管机构网络密切合作，分析反映政策驱动转型和不断演变的物理风险的气候情景。
AI.findings: 气候风险对短期经济和金融风险产生显著情景依赖性影响。主权违约风险在大多数国家增加超过一个百分点，在某些行业高达三十个百分点。当考虑金融影响对宏观经济动态的反馈效应时，GDP损失估计值平均放大三分之一，在某些地区和情景下高达两倍。
AI.theory_contributions: 开发了首个能够量化评估气候风险短期金融和宏观经济影响的整合建模框架，弥补了现有IAM模型的不足。
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管机构和政策制定者提供了评估气候相关金融风险的工具，有助于识别脆弱部门和地区，制定相应的风险管理策略。

title: Competitive Advantage in the Age of AI: Implications for Accounting Research
affiliations: Aalto University School of Business and Aalto University School of Business

detail.title: Competitive Advantage in the Age of AI: Implications for Accounting Research
detail.abstract: Artificial intelligence challenges the traditional sources of competitive advantage for accounting researchers. We develop a conceptual framework based on two dimensions where humans retain strengths: higher-order reasoning and control over data access. Applying this framework suggests that over 90% of published accounting studies use methods highly exposed to AI-supported competition, with archival research particularly vulnerable because of its general reliance on public data and standardized methods. Our framework predicts that researchers lacking comparative advantage in AI deployment will increasingly pursue proprietary data-leveraging the access dimension-or emphasize higher-order reasoning, where AI provides limited substitution. It also predicts that doctoral programs will increasingly emphasize these two dimensions in admissions and training. However, our review of 30 leading doctoral programs shows little explicit integration of AI into curricula or stated priorities, indicating that the very institutions responsible for preparing future researchers remain unprepared for the technological disruption their graduates will face.

AI.tldr: 该研究构建了一个基于高阶推理和数据访问控制两个维度的概念框架，分析AI对会计研究竞争力的挑战。研究发现90%以上的会计研究论文使用的方法高度暴露于AI竞争风险，特别是依赖公共数据和标准化方法的档案研究。预测缺乏AI比较优势的研究者将转向专有数据或高阶推理，但博士项目尚未充分整合AI培训。
AI.research_question: AI如何挑战会计研究者的传统竞争优势来源？研究者应如何应对AI带来的竞争压力？
AI.motivation: 人工智能正在挑战会计研究者的传统竞争优势，需要识别人类在哪些维度上仍保持相对优势，并为研究者提供应对策略。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于两个关键维度构建概念框架：1）高阶推理能力；2）数据访问控制权。这两个维度是人类相对于AI保持优势的领域。
AI.method: 概念框架开发与文献分析，结合对30个领先博士项目的课程审查。
AI.findings: 90%以上的已发表会计研究使用的方法高度暴露于AI竞争；档案研究尤其脆弱；博士项目尚未充分整合AI培训。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个分析AI对研究竞争力影响的概念框架，识别了人类研究者的相对优势领域。
AI.practical_contributions: 为会计研究者提供了应对AI竞争的策略方向：专有数据获取和高阶推理能力培养；为博士项目改革提供了建议。

title: Deposit Diversification and the Term Structure of Bank Debt
affiliations: University of Rochester - Simon Business School, Students

detail.title: Deposit Diversification and the Term Structure of Bank Debt
detail.abstract: Opacity is key in bank funding. It facilitates the provision of liquidity to impatient depositors while stimulating investment in profitable but illiquid and risky assets. In a dynamic model with asset monitoring, we show that deposit diversification endogenously creates opacity about asset quality. This, in turn, allows banks to create liquidity and efficiently transform maturity (Dang et al. (2017)). Several empirical predictions follow. Higher deposit diversity leads to (i) more liquidity creation (shorter term liability structure); (ii) higher bank value; and (iii) lower default risk. Empirically, these predictions are consistent with the evidence on the geographical expansion of banks.

AI.tldr: 本文通过动态模型分析发现，存款多样化内生地创造了资产质量的不透明性，这种不透明性使银行能够创造流动性并有效进行期限转换。实证预测表明，更高的存款多样性会导致更多流动性创造、更高银行价值和更低违约风险。
AI.research_question: 存款多样化如何影响银行的不透明性、流动性创造和风险？
AI.motivation: 银行的不透明性在资金获取中至关重要，它有助于为缺乏耐心的储户提供流动性，同时促进对盈利但缺乏流动性和风险资产的投​​资。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于资产监控的动态模型，借鉴Dang et al. (2017)的流动性创造和期限转换理论。
AI.method: 理论模型构建与实证预测验证，结合银行地理扩张的证据。
AI.findings: 存款多样化内生地创造资产质量不透明性；更高的存款多样性导致更多流动性创造、更高银行价值和更低违约风险。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了存款多样化与银行不透明性之间的内生关系，完善了银行流动性创造理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为银行通过存款多样化策略优化流动性管理和风险管理提供了理论依据，对银行监管政策具有启示意义。

title: Beyond the Turing Test: A Framework for the "Personality Test" to Evaluate the Authenticity of a Specific Simulated Identity

detail.title: Beyond the Turing Test: A Framework for the "Personality Test" to Evaluate the Authenticity of a Specific Simulated Identity

detail.abstract: The Turing Test has long served as the foundational benchmark for artificial intelligence, equating success with the imitation of generic human behavior. However, with the rise of a new generation of personalized AI systems, such as digital twins and personality simulators, this paradigm of indistinguishability proves insufficient. An AI's ability to imitate an arbitrary human is a fundamentally different and less meaningful measure than its ability to be authentic to a specifichuman. This paper introduces the "Personality Test," a new conceptual framework and multi-modal evaluation protocol designed to measure the authenticity of a specific simulated identity. We argue for a paradigm shift from indistinguishability to authenticity, positioning a "close other"-an individual intimately familiar with the creator as the primary arbiter of a simulation's success. The proposed framework is built on three complementary pillars: (1) a qualitative, double-blind protocol for validating perceived authenticity; (2) a quantitative analysis of stylistic similarity across linguistic and prosodic domains; and (3) a quantitative comparison of cognitive similarity using established psychometric instruments. By integrating methodologies from AI, Human-Computer Interaction, and psychology, the Personality Test provides a robust, replicable, and more human-centered standard for evaluating personalized AI. We present this framework as a necessary evolution in AI benchmarking, essential for the responsible development of technologies that are becoming deeply integrated into our social and emotional lives.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"人格测试"作为新的AI评估框架，从传统的图灵测试转向关注特定身份模拟的真实性，强调从不可区分性向真实性的范式转变。

AI.theoretical_framework: 人格测试框架，基于从不可区分性到真实性的范式转变，以"亲密他人"作为模拟成功的主要评判者。
AI.method: 三支柱方法：(1) 双盲定性协议验证感知真实性；(2) 语言和韵律领域的风格相似性定量分析；(3) 使用心理测量工具进行认知相似性定量比较。
AI.findings: 人格测试提供了一个稳健、可复制且更以人为本的个性化AI评估标准。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了从图灵测试到人格测试的范式转变，建立了以真实性为核心的新评估理论框架。

title: Cross-State Job Stealing
affiliations: National Tsing Hua University - Department of Quantitative Finance, Hong Kong Polytechnic University and City University of Hong Kong

detail.title: Cross-State Job Stealing
detail.abstract: Using a comprehensive dataset of U.S. job postings, we study how state R&D tax credits influence firms' geographic allocation of talent recruitment. We find that a firm's local demand for R&D labor significantly decreases with R&D tax credits offered by other states in which the firm currently operates. This relation has a causal interpretation because (i) we control for the fixed effects of other states; (ii) the reduced local recruitment occurs after sharp increases in out-of-state R&D tax credits but not before; and (iii) we find no corresponding decrease in non-R&D recruitment. This negative spillover reflects a form of "job stealing" in which tax incentives in one state draw skilled labor demand away from others. The substitution effect is more pronounced for R&D-intensive firms and financially constrained firms, as well as for situations in which other states offer abundant talent supply, thus making it easier to meet increased labor demand there. We also observe a similar spillover effect on inventor counts and patenting activity, both of which decline with out-of-state R&D tax credits. Overall, our findings highlight the redistributive impact of R&D tax credits on the geography of firms' demand for innovation labor.

AI.tldr: 本研究使用美国职位发布数据，发现州级研发税收抵免政策会导致企业减少在其他运营州的研发人才招聘，形成"工作窃取"效应。这种负向溢出效应在研发密集型企业、财务约束企业以及人才供给充足的情况下更为明显。

AI.method: 使用美国职位发布综合数据集，采用固定效应模型，控制其他州的固定效应，利用外生政策变化进行因果识别。
AI.findings: 企业本地研发劳动力需求随其他运营州研发税收抵免增加而显著减少；这种替代效应在研发密集型企业、财务约束企业和人才供给充足地区更明显；发明者数量和专利申请活动也出现类似负向溢出。

title: Dividend Policy, Growth, And the Valuation of Shares Revisited (With Addendum)
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Dividend Policy, Growth, And the Valuation of Shares Revisited (With Addendum)
detail.abstract: In the first draft of this paper published by SSRN in September, 2025, I argued that the market would place a higher value on the shares of a corporation that retained all its earnings if that corporation evidence for this propisition began paying dividends. I offered circumstantial but no actual examples. In this paper I present in an addendum empirical evidence that the market places a higher value on the shares of corporations with equal earning power but which pay dividends, with the valuation rising with an increase in the payout ratio. Other than this paragraph in the abstract and the Addendum, this paper is unchanged from the original. Two studies demonstrate the rate at which corporations that corporate earnings grow directly and positively with retain their earnings. One study analyses the relation between historical retention and growth rates of the S&P 500 index, the other is a longitudinal corporations study which examines the retention and growth rates of individual during the period from 2004 through 2024. This second study also shows the deciles of corporate stocks sorted by retention rates will have approximately same mean price-to-earnings the levels. The market values the high volatility stocks of companies with high retention levels and high growth rates equally with the low volatility stocks of companies with low retention and low growth rates. The data imply that during the 2004-2024 period the market valued a dollar of dividends more than a dollar of earnings, contrary to the "dividend paper also demonstrates irrelevency" conjecture of Miller and Modigliani. This how studies which find earnings growing slower after high retention levels and faster after low retention levels are the result of earnings falling in recessions and growing rapidly thereafter.

AI.tldr: 该论文通过实证研究表明，市场对支付股息的股票给予更高估值，且估值随股息支付率的增加而上升。研究还发现企业收益增长与留存收益呈正相关，但高留存率后的收益增长放缓主要是由于经济衰退导致收益下降，随后快速反弹。
AI.research_question: 市场是否对支付股息的股票给予更高估值？企业留存收益与收益增长之间的关系如何？
AI.motivation: 验证股息支付对股票估值的影响，以及企业留存收益策略与收益增长之间的实际关系，挑战Miller和Modigliani的股息无关理论。
AI.theoretical_framework: 股息政策理论、企业估值理论、Miller和Modigliani的股息无关理论
AI.method: 实证研究方法，包括对S&P 500指数的历史留存与增长率关系分析，以及对2004-2024年间个股的纵向研究
AI.findings: 1) 市场对支付股息的股票给予更高估值，估值随股息支付率增加而上升；2) 企业收益增长与留存收益呈正相关；3) 高留存率公司的高波动性股票与低留存率公司的低波动性股票获得相同估值；4) 市场对1美元股息的估值高于1美元收益

title: Conflict Exposure and Firm Investment
affiliations: University of Bergen

detail.title: Conflict Exposure and Firm Investment
detail.abstract: We introduce a novel measure of firm-level exposure to armed conflict that captures operational disruptions due to localized military activity. Our framework integrates three granular components: static regional vulnerabilities to targeting and occupation, dynamic geocoded reports of military incidents and territorial control, and each firm's pre-conflict establishment-level workforce distribution across affected regions. This approach provides time-varying measures that quantify how localized conflict shocks propagate through multinational firms' operational networks. Applying this framework to Russia's 2022 invasion of Ukraine across multinational firms in 44 countries, we document that higher conflict exposure reduces market valuations and capital expenditures while simultaneously increasing \rd spending. This compositional shift reveals that extreme geopolitical shocks trigger strategic reallocations from physical to knowledge-based capital rather than uniform retrenchment. U.S. firms exhibit sharper investment responses than non-U.S. counterparts facing identical conflict exposures, suggesting that institutional and market structures shape how firms adapt their investment strategies under extreme operational disruptions.

AI.tldr: 本文开发了一种衡量企业层面武装冲突暴露度的新方法，通过整合区域脆弱性、动态军事事件和企业员工分布数据，量化冲突冲击如何通过跨国公司运营网络传播。研究发现高冲突暴露度会降低企业市场估值和资本支出，但增加研发投入，表明企业会从实物资本转向知识资本的战略重新配置。

AI.method: 整合三个粒度组件：静态区域脆弱性、动态地理编码军事事件、企业战前员工区域分布，构建时间变化的冲突暴露度指标，应用于2022年俄乌冲突中的44国跨国公司。

title: When Research Speeds Up but Journals Do Not: AI's Impact on Accounting Publishing
affiliations: Aalto University School of Business and Aalto University School of Business

detail.title: When Research Speeds Up but Journals Do Not: AI's Impact on Accounting Publishing
detail.abstract: This paper examines how advances in artificial intelligence (AI) affect academic publishing in accounting. Using interviews with senior editors, analysis of publisher policies and statistics, and a combination of theoretical perspectives, we develop four key predictions. First, heightened obsolescence risk may lead accounting researchers to pursue narrower, faster projects and converge more quickly on appropriate journals. Second, declining research production costs may increase submissions especially to lower-tier journals, straining review capacity and potentially raising submission fees. Third, centralized publisher platforms may drive AI adoption through institutional isomorphism, pressuring accounting researchers to align their work with standardized, crossdisciplinary templates. Fourth, extended publication delays may weaken informal intellectual property protections, as AI enables rapid replication of circulated working papers at low cost. Although editors recognize the need for reform, the decentralized, volunteer-based peer review system remains resistant to change, potentially creating opportunities for alternative publication models.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨人工智能对会计学术出版的影响，预测了四个主要趋势：研究主题窄化、投稿量增加、平台标准化压力、知识产权保护弱化，同时指出同行评审系统的变革阻力。
