title: From Unicorn Growth to Buffalo Strength: Rethinking Resilience in Asset Pricing
affiliations: University of Colorado at Denver - Department of Finance

detail.title: From Unicorn Growth to Buffalo Strength: Rethinking Resilience in Asset Pricing
detail.abstract: This paper introduces the Buffalo Investing framework, a new approach to measuring and investing in financial resilience, while contrasting it with the rapid-growth logic of Unicorn Investing. We develop the Buffalo Ratio, defined as the relationship between persistence and innovation volatility, to quantify how consistently a sector sustains performance amid shocks. Using monthly data for the 49 Fama-French industries and the S&P 500 from 2000 to 2025, the analysis proceeds in two steps. In the first step, we estimate AR(1) and CAPM models for each sector to obtain the deep parameters, alpha, persistence, innovation volatility, and market beta, and compute sector-level Buffalo Ratios. In the second step, we regress the Buffalo Ratio on sector alpha and beta to identify the drivers of resilience. Results show that persistence and controlled volatility generate higher Buffalo performance, while greater average drift and market exposure tend to reduce stability. The findings highlight a new dimension of asset classification, Buffalo sectors, that combine persistence, low innovation noise, and adaptive strength, offering investors a resilience-based complement to traditional growth-oriented Unicorn and passive (market) investing strategies.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了Buffalo投资框架，通过定义Buffalo比率（持久性与创新波动性之比）来衡量金融韧性，并与独角兽投资的快速增长逻辑形成对比。研究发现持久性和可控波动性能够产生更高的Buffalo表现，而平均漂移和市场暴露会降低稳定性。
AI.research_question: 如何衡量和投资于金融韧性？Buffalo比率与行业表现之间的关系是什么？
AI.motivation: 传统投资策略主要关注快速增长（如独角兽投资），但缺乏对金融韧性的系统衡量方法。需要开发一个能够量化行业在冲击中持续表现能力的框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: Buffalo投资框架、Buffalo比率（持久性/创新波动性）、AR(1)模型、CAPM模型
AI.method: 使用2000-2025年49个Fama-French行业和S&P 500的月度数据，分两步分析：1）估计各行业的AR(1)和CAPM模型获取深度参数；2）将Buffalo比率对行业alpha和beta进行回归分析
AI.findings: 持久性和可控波动性产生更高的Buffalo表现，平均漂移和市场暴露会降低稳定性。识别出Buffalo行业具有持久性、低创新噪声和适应性强等特点。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了Buffalo投资理论框架，定义了Buffalo比率作为金融韧性的量化指标，建立了资产分类的新维度。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者提供了基于韧性的投资策略，补充了传统的增长导向型独角兽投资和被动投资策略，帮助构建更具抗冲击能力的投资组合。

It outlines the incentives, market failures, and policy levers that shape the development and diffusion of clean technologies; traces global patterns in technology development and deployment; and highlights frontier challenges and open questions related to climate adaptation, critical mineral supply chains, artificial intelligence, and geopolitics. The analysis explores the role of effective climate policy, stressing the relevance of coordinated approaches that match instruments to technology maturity and local context.

detail.title: Navigating the Metaverse: Unravelling Employees’ Sentiments and Satisfaction from Metaverse-Based Training Reviews
detail.abstract: Purpose: The metaverse is described as the next disruptive technology that bears the promise of fundamentally revolutionizing the way businesses perform their functions. The potential of the metaverse is being rapidly propelled by its growing integration into business operations and multimillion-dollar corporate investments in developing metaverse-related technologies. Despite its rapid evaluation, the metaverse's scope and its implications for human resource development function is less known. Using the machine learning approaches, this study explores and demonstrates the implications of the metaverse in employee training and development function. Research findings/insights: Specifically, this study utilizes deep learning fine-grained sentiment analysis on a large quantity of employees' online reviews about metaverse-based leading training platforms: STRIVR, Spatial Computing, Mursion, Program ACE, Rewo, Gather, and ARKit, to explore employees' sentiments and examine their connection with satisfaction ratings. The findings show that real-time collaboration is the area that most positive sentiments are linked to, followed by customized platform, real-time analytics, and technology-training fit. Cybersecurity concern is the main aspect that triggers negative sentiments among trainees. The relationship between employee sentiments and satisfaction appears strong, indicating that these two aspects of employee experiences are inherently connected. Theoretical/academic implications: This study contributes to the burgeoning literature that tries to build meaningful insight into the possible opportunities for organizations in the metaverse by highlighting its potential in human resource development. This study is among the earliest to examine the new phenomenon of using the metaverse in employee training. Practitioner/policy implications: The implications of the study offer useful insights for businesses transitioning from conventional to metaverse-based HR processes in the future. To implement metaverse-based training programs into training and development functions, HR managers must understand the sentiments and satisfaction levels of employees that attended such training.

AI.tldr: 本研究使用深度学习细粒度情感分析探索元宇宙在员工培训中的应用，发现实时协作、定制化平台、实时分析和技术培训匹配度是积极情感的主要来源，而网络安全问题是负面情感的主要触发因素。
AI.research_question: 元宇宙在员工培训与发展功能中的影响是什么？
AI.motivation: 元宇宙作为颠覆性技术正在快速融入企业运营，但其在人力资源开发中的具体应用和影响尚不明确。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于元宇宙技术和人力资源开发理论，结合深度学习情感分析方法。
AI.method: 使用深度学习细粒度情感分析，对员工在元宇宙培训平台（STRIVR、Spatial Computing等）的在线评论进行大规模分析。
AI.findings: 实时协作是积极情感最多的领域，其次是定制化平台、实时分析和技术培训匹配度。网络安全问题是负面情感的主要来源。员工情感与满意度之间存在强相关关系。
AI.theory_contributions: 为理解元宇宙在组织中的潜在机会提供理论见解，是首批研究元宇宙在员工培训中应用的实证研究之一。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业从传统HR流程向基于元宇宙的HR流程转型提供实用指导，帮助HR管理者理解员工对元宇宙培训的情感和满意度。

title: Efficiency Implies Legitimacy: Optimal Sanctions Under Participation Constraints of the baeKKim Model
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Efficiency Implies Legitimacy: Optimal Sanctions Under Participation Constraints of the baeKKim Model

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that they have no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This research did not receive any specific grant from funding agencies in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.
declarations.funderStatement: This study is a theoretical work and does not involve human participants, therefore ethics approval was not required.

detail.abstract:
This paper investigates the conditions under which an efficient sanction policy achieves normative legitimacy within the theoretical framework of the baeKKim model. This model conceptualizes the state as a "reasoning agent" that allocates a zero-sum pool of "indirect freedom" delegated by citizens. Legitimacy requires satisfying two key participation constraints: citizens must receive at least their alternative utility from direct freedom (citizen participation constraint), and the state's net contribution from sanctions must be non-negative (government participation constraint).

Using a Lagrangian optimization approach, we formulate a social planner's problem to maximize a welfare function subject to these constraints. Our main result, "Theorem 1: Efficiency Implies Legitimacy," establishes a set of sufficient conditions under which a Pareto- or Kaldor-Hicks-efficient sanction policy is guaranteed to be legitimate. These conditions include the individualization of sanctions based on citizen heterogeneity and ensuring the policy constitutes a welfare improvement over the status quo.

Furthermore, we conduct a comparative statics analysis to demonstrate how optimal sanction levels respond monotonically to changes in citizen heterogeneity and sanction technology. A calibrated numerical example illustrates our theoretical findings. The analysis provides a formal theoretical basis for understanding the institutional design of sanctions, clarifying the relationship between efficiency and legitimacy in a delegation-based model of democracy.

AI.tldr: 本文在baeKKim模型框架下研究有效制裁政策获得规范合法性的条件。通过拉格朗日优化方法，证明了在公民异质性和福利改进等条件下，帕累托或卡尔多-希克斯有效的制裁政策必然具有合法性。
AI.research_question: 在什么条件下，有效的制裁政策能够获得规范合法性？
AI.motivation: 理解在授权民主模型中，效率与合法性之间的关系，为制裁制度的制度设计提供理论基础。
AI.theoretical_framework: baeKKim模型，将国家概念化为分配公民委托的"间接自由"零和池的"推理代理人"
AI.method: 拉格朗日优化方法，制定受参与约束的社会规划者福利最大化问题，并进行比较静态分析和数值校准示例
AI.findings: 定理1：效率意味着合法性 - 在公民异质性个体化制裁和福利改进等条件下，有效制裁政策必然合法；最优制裁水平对公民异质性和制裁技术变化呈单调响应
AI.theory_contributions: 为理解制裁制度设计提供了正式理论基础，阐明了授权民主模型中效率与合法性的关系
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者设计合法有效的制裁制度提供了理论指导，明确了满足公民和政府参与约束的关键条件

detail.title: Analysing the Performance of India's TBTF (Too Big To Fail) Banks: D-SIBs and RBI Norms

declarations.funderStatement: The authors declare no conflict of interest.

detail.abstract: Performance analysis of big banks is very much crucial for the economy as they stand high and performance below the expected level can create a big disruption to the banking sector. In Indian context, the regulator RBI has identified three banks which are big and systematically strong as D-SIBs (Domestic Systematically Important Banks) which are Too Big To Fail (TBTF) as they contribute more to the development of Indian banking sector. The performance of these banks should be analysed based on certain norms set from time to time as per Industry requirements. The present study is done on these three banks by comparing their performance based on benchmarks set by RBI. The analysis results are assigned with scores enabling composite weighted scoring. The study reveals that Private banks are performing well in most of the benchmarks where as the largest Public sector bank could not meet the expectations in major benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 该研究分析了印度三家被认定为国内系统重要性银行(D-SIBs)的大型银行绩效，通过RBI设定的基准进行比较评估，发现私营银行在多数基准上表现良好，而最大的公共部门银行在主要基准上未能达到预期。
AI.research_question: 印度三家国内系统重要性银行(D-SIBs)的绩效表现如何？它们是否满足监管机构设定的基准要求？
AI.motivation: 大型银行的绩效分析对经济至关重要，因为它们规模庞大且具有系统重要性，表现不佳可能对整个银行业造成重大干扰。
AI.theoretical_framework: 系统重要性银行理论、银行绩效评估理论、监管基准理论
AI.method: 基于RBI设定的基准对三家D-SIBs银行进行绩效比较分析，采用复合加权评分方法
AI.findings: 私营银行在大多数基准上表现良好，而最大的公共部门银行在主要基准上未能达到预期水平
AI.theory_contributions: 为系统重要性银行绩效评估提供了实证支持，完善了银行监管基准理论的应用
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管机构提供银行绩效评估的实用方法，帮助识别银行体系中的薄弱环节

title: The Physical Core of the Economy
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: The Physical Core of the Economy
detail.abstract: In conventional economics, quantities are measured in money, which obscures the underlying physical reality. The economy is, however, a physical process in which human labor is transformed into order-into goods and services-and in which consumption increases entropy again. In this article the economy is formally reduced to its physical core: labor time, productivity, and trade. Money, prices, and interest appear as emergent feedback mechanisms of a deeper energetic system. The proposed model links Marx's labor theory of value with Keynes's administrative and monetary insights. It shows that sustainable growth is possible only when physical capacity-productive labor time, adjusted for technology and international exchange-increases. Policies that affect only the symbolic layers without strengthening this capacity have merely temporary effects. The physical analysis thus reveals that the economic cycle is essentially a thermodynamic process of energy and entropy transformation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将经济简化为物理核心：劳动时间、生产率和贸易，认为货币、价格和利率是更深层能量系统的涌现反馈机制，将马克思劳动价值论与凯恩斯货币理论相结合，揭示经济增长本质上是能量和熵转化的热力学过程。
AI.research_question: 如何从物理角度理解经济系统的本质？经济增长的物理基础是什么？
AI.motivation: 传统经济学用货币衡量经济量，掩盖了经济作为物理过程的本质。经济实际上是劳动转化为秩序（商品和服务）、消费增加熵的物理过程。
AI.theoretical_framework: 马克思劳动价值论、凯恩斯货币理论、热力学理论
AI.method: 构建将经济简化为物理核心的形式化模型，分析劳动时间、生产率和贸易的物理关系
AI.findings: 可持续增长只有在物理产能（经技术和国际贸易调整的生产性劳动时间）增加时才可能实现；仅影响符号层面而不增强物理能力的政策只有暂时效果
AI.theory_contributions: 将经济理论建立在物理基础上，统一了劳动价值论和货币理论，揭示了经济周期的热力学本质
AI.practical_contributions: 为制定真正有效的经济政策提供物理基础，强调必须关注实体产能而非仅货币层面

title: The Post-Truth Divide: How Media Shapes Voting in Türkiye's Political Duopoly
affiliations: Gebze Technical University

detail.title: The Post-Truth Divide: How Media Shapes Voting in Türkiye's Political Duopoly
detail.abstract: This paper examines the voting influence of post-truth, quantified through a novel measure that combines epistemic error and false confidence. By employing data collected from 2,163 Turkish participants in the World Values Survey, the posttruth phenomenon does not have a direct influence on the duopolies. Instead, this phenomenon increases support for the ruling JDP by 5.8% through social media, while exposure to or use of news decreases support for the main opposition RPP by 4.5%. These results suggest that post-truth impacts are context-dependent and that social media use and news exposure may reinforce people's voting behaviour in Türkiye.

AI.tldr: 本文通过结合认知错误和虚假信心的新指标量化后真相现象，发现后真相并不直接影响土耳其的两党制，而是通过社交媒体使执政党JDP支持率增加5.8%，同时新闻接触使主要反对党RPP支持率减少4.5%。
AI.research_question: 后真相现象如何影响土耳其的投票行为？
AI.motivation: 探讨后真相政治在土耳其选举中的具体影响机制，特别是在社交媒体和传统新闻环境下的不同作用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 后真相理论、认知错误与虚假信心理论、媒体效应理论
AI.method: 使用世界价值观调查中2,163名土耳其参与者的数据，采用结合认知错误和虚假信心的新测量方法进行量化分析
AI.findings: 后真相现象不直接影响两党制，但通过社交媒体使执政党JDP支持率增加5.8%，新闻接触使反对党RPP支持率减少4.5%
AI.theory_contributions: 提出后真相影响的情境依赖性理论，揭示社交媒体和传统新闻在强化投票行为中的不同作用机制
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解土耳其选举动态提供实证依据，对政治传播策略和媒体政策制定具有参考价值

title: Climate Change, Agricultural Productivity, and Food Inflation in Nigeria
affiliations: Nile University of Nigeria and Central Bank of Nigeria

detail.title: Climate Change, Agricultural Productivity, and Food Inflation in Nigeria
detail.abstract: This study investigates the macroeconomic implications of climate change on food inflation dynamics in Nigeria using a Structural Vector Autoregressive (SVAR) model. Drawing on monthly data spanning 1995M1-2024M11, the analysis identifies how temperature and rainfall shocks propagate through agricultural output and food prices. The results reveal strong contemporaneous and short-run effects of adverse climate shocks on agricultural production and food inflation, indicating that weather-induced supply disruptions remain a major source of inflationary pressure. However, these effects are largely transitory, suggesting that persistent food inflation arises from structural constraints such as low productivity and inadequate climate adaptation infrastructure. Diagnostic tests confirm model stability, though evidence of residual heteroskedasticity and non-normality reflects the volatility inherent in climate-economic interactions. The impulse response and forecast error variance decomposition results demonstrate that favorable climatic conditions exert mild but short-lived disinflationary effects. The findings highlight the limits of conventional monetary policy in addressing climate-driven food inflation and underscore the need for coordinated policy responses that integrate climate adaptation, agricultural investment, and forward-looking monetary policy frameworks. Strengthening agro-climatic monitoring and incorporating climate risk indicators into inflation forecasting can enhance the Central Bank's capacity to maintain price stability under growing climate uncertainty.

AI.tldr: 本研究使用SVAR模型分析气候变化对尼日利亚食品通胀的宏观经济影响，发现不利气候冲击对农业生产和食品价格有显著短期影响，但长期通胀主要源于结构性约束。研究强调需要整合气候适应、农业投资和前瞻性货币政策来应对气候驱动的食品通胀。
AI.research_question: 气候变化如何通过温度、降雨等气候冲击影响尼日利亚的食品通胀动态？
AI.motivation: 理解气候冲击在食品通胀形成中的作用，为政策制定提供依据，特别是在气候不确定性日益增加的背景下。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于结构向量自回归(SVAR)模型，分析气候冲击对农业产出和食品价格的传导机制。
AI.method: 使用1995年1月至2024年11月的月度数据，构建SVAR模型，进行脉冲响应分析和预测误差方差分解。
AI.findings: 不利气候冲击对农业生产和食品通胀有显著的同期和短期影响，但这些影响主要是暂时的；有利气候条件具有温和但短暂的通缩效应。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了气候冲击在食品通胀形成中的传导机制，强调了结构性约束在长期通胀中的主导作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为中央银行提供了整合气候风险指标的通胀预测框架，强调了气候适应、农业投资与货币政策协调的必要性。

title: Lessons from Complex Systems Science for AI Governance
affiliations: Hebrew University of Jerusalem, Hebrew University of Jerusalem, Faculty of Law and Bar-Ilan University - Department of Mathematics

detail.title: Lessons from Complex Systems Science for AI Governance
detail.abstract: The study of complex adaptive systems, pioneered in physics, biology, and the social sciences, offers important lessons for AI governance. Contemporary AI systems and the environments in which they operate exhibit many of the properties characteristic of complex systems, including nonlinear growth patterns, emergent phenomena, and cascading effects that can lead to catastrophic failures. Complex systems science can help illuminate the features of AI that pose central challenges for policymakers, such as feedback loops induced by training AI models on synthetic data and the interconnectedness between AI systems and critical infrastructure. Drawing on insights from other domains shaped by complex systems, including public health and climate change, we examine how efforts to govern AI are marked by deep uncertainty. To contend with this challenge, we propose three desiderata for designing a set of complexity-compatible AI governance principles comprised of early and scalable intervention, adaptive institutional design, and risk thresholds calibrated to trigger timely and effective regulatory responses.

AI.tldr: 该论文探讨了复杂适应系统理论在AI治理中的应用，指出AI系统具有复杂系统的非线性增长、涌现现象和级联效应等特征，并提出了三个复杂性兼容的AI治理原则。
AI.research_question: 如何将复杂系统科学的见解应用于AI治理，以应对AI系统带来的深层次不确定性挑战？
AI.motivation: 当代AI系统及其运行环境展现出复杂系统的特性，如非线性增长模式、涌现现象和级联效应，这些特性给政策制定者带来了重大挑战。
AI.theoretical_framework: 复杂适应系统理论，借鉴物理学、生物学和社会科学中的复杂系统研究。
AI.method: 基于对其他领域（如公共卫生和气候变化）复杂系统治理经验的比较分析，提出AI治理原则。
AI.findings: AI治理面临深度不确定性，复杂系统科学可以帮助识别AI系统的关键挑战特征，如合成数据训练引发的反馈循环和AI系统与关键基础设施的互联性。
AI.theory_contributions: 将复杂系统理论框架系统性地应用于AI治理领域，为理解AI系统的复杂行为提供了理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出了三个复杂性兼容的AI治理原则：早期可扩展干预、适应性制度设计、以及基于风险阈值触发及时有效监管响应。

title: Social connectedness and the cost of bank loans
affiliations: Monash University, affiliation not provided to SSRN, Monash University and Monash University

detail.title: Social connectedness and the cost of bank loans
detail.abstract: This paper investigates the impact of social connectedness between borrowers and lenders on the cost of private debt for U.S. firms over the period 2012-2020. We employ the Social Connectedness Index (SCI) to measure the level of social connectedness between two counties, and find that borrowers with higher social proximity to the lenders are charged lower loan spreads. Our results also show that the relation between social connectedness and cost of bank loans is more pronounced among firms located farther away from the lenders. In addition, we document that the effect of social connectedness on cost of bank loans is largely observed among informationally opaque borrowers and among smaller syndicates with fewer distinct lenders. We also find a negative and significant association between social connectedness and loan size. Lastly, we do not find evidence on the relation between social connectedness and bank loan maturity and the intensity of financial covenants. Taken together, our findings suggest that social connectedness between borrowers and lenders has informational benefit in reducing the risks and uncertainties in the private debt market.

AI.tldr: 本文研究发现，借款人与贷款人之间的社会联系度越高，私人债务成本越低，这种效应在信息不透明的借款人和规模较小的银团中更为明显。
AI.research_question: 借款人与贷款人之间的社会联系度如何影响美国企业的私人债务成本？
AI.motivation: 探讨社会联系在私人债务市场中的信息价值及其对融资成本的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于社会网络理论和信息不对称理论，认为社会联系能够降低信息不对称，从而减少融资成本。
AI.method: 使用2012-2020年数据，采用社会联系指数(SCI)衡量县际社会联系度，分析其对贷款利差的影响。
AI.findings: 社会联系度与贷款利差负相关；距离越远效应越明显；信息不透明借款人和小银团中效应更强；社会联系与贷款规模负相关；与贷款期限和财务契约强度无关。
AI.theory_contributions: 拓展了社会网络在金融领域的应用，证实社会联系具有信息价值，能够降低私人债务市场的不确定性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业和金融机构提供了利用社会网络优化融资决策的实践指导，特别是对信息不透明的中小企业具有重要参考价值。

title: Paying AI to Detect AI
affiliations: and The University of Osaka - Institute of Social and Economic Research

detail.title: Paying AI to Detect AI

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare no competing interests.
declarations.ethicsApproval: The design of the experiment reported in this paper was approved by the Research Ethics Committee at the ISER (#20240904) and the Research Ethics Committee at the Research Institute for Socionetwork Strategies (RISS), Kansai University (#2024030).
declarations.funderStatement: This research has benefited from the financial support of (a) the Joint Usage/Research Center, the Institute of Social and Economic Research (ISER), the University of Osaka, and (b) Grants-in-aid for Scientific Research (No.23H00055 and No.25H00388) from the Japan Society for the Promotion of Science.

detail.abstract: We embed a ChatGPT-based AI detector in a laboratory experiment to test whether participants are willing to pay more to collaborate with AI than with human peers to accurately detect the proportion of AI-generated parts in deepfake news articles. Task difficulty varies with the model used to generate the articles (GPT-2 vs. GPT-4o). We find that participants' willingness to pay (WTP) for the AI detector exceeds that to collaborate with human peers, even though the AI detector does not provide better assistance and, in fact, humans do better than AI in for GPT-4o generated news. WTP for AI or peer collaboration does not rise with task difficulty. These patterns point to over-reliance on AI and raise concerns about the spread of deepfakes. The study improves understanding of human-AI interaction and informs safeguards for deepfake detection in the era of generative AI (GAI).

AI.tldr: 实验发现参与者更愿意付费使用AI检测器而非与人类合作检测深度伪造新闻，尽管AI检测器并未提供更好帮助且人类在检测GPT-4o生成新闻时表现更优。这种对AI的过度依赖令人担忧。
AI.research_question: 参与者是否愿意支付更多费用与AI合作而非与人类同伴合作来准确检测深度伪造新闻中AI生成部分的比例？
AI.motivation: 测试在深度伪造检测任务中人类对AI的依赖程度，关注生成式AI时代中人类与AI互动模式及其对深度伪造传播的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 人类-AI互动理论、技术接受模型、决策偏见理论
AI.method: 实验室实验，嵌入ChatGPT-based AI检测器，任务难度随生成模型（GPT-2 vs. GPT-4o）变化，测量支付意愿(WTP)

title: Robotic Versus Traditional Capital Complementarity and Economic Growth in the Era of Full Automation
affiliations: University of Milan - Department of Business Policy and Economics, Vienna University of Economics and Business - Department of Economics and Université Paris VIII Vincennes-Saint-Denis

detail.title: Robotic Versus Traditional Capital Complementarity and Economic Growth in the Era of Full Automation
detail.abstract: How will the widespread deployment of automation technologies such as industrial robots and artificial intelligence (AI) affect long-run economic performance? To address this question, we develop a model of economic growth for a fully automated economy in which output is produced with only two forms of capital: "traditional capital" (assembly lines, machines, etc.) and "robotic capital" (industrial robots, AI, etc.). In our setting, human labor is no longer competitive, and the central questions become how investment should be allocated across the two types of capital and how the degree of substitutability between them affects longterm economic growth. Using a two-level nested CES production structure (with no further assumptions), we characterize the competitive balanced growth path and the range of feasible long-run growth rates that a fully automated economy can attain. We show that the case of full automation can be consistent with the growth expectations of techno-optimists and the dynamics of economic growth along a balanced growth path depend on preference parameters, depreciation, and the degree of substitutability between robotic and traditional capital in both production and investment decisions. Our framework contributes to the debate on the economic consequences of automation and the extent to which this future is shaped by the underlying forces that determine the accumulation of traditional capital versus robotic capital.

AI.tldr: 本文开发了一个完全自动化经济体的增长模型，研究当人力劳动不再具有竞争力时，传统资本和机器人资本之间的替代性如何影响长期经济增长。
AI.research_question: 自动化技术（工业机器人和人工智能）的广泛部署如何影响长期经济表现？
AI.motivation: 探讨在人力劳动不再具有竞争力的完全自动化经济中，投资应如何在传统资本和机器人资本之间分配，以及两者之间的替代程度如何影响长期经济增长。
AI.theoretical_framework: 完全自动化经济体的经济增长模型，采用两层嵌套CES生产结构，假设产出仅由传统资本（装配线、机器等）和机器人资本（工业机器人、AI等）生产。
AI.method: 使用两层嵌套CES生产结构（无进一步假设），刻画竞争性平衡增长路径和完全自动化经济可达到的长期增长率范围。
AI.findings: 完全自动化情况与技术乐观主义者的增长预期一致，平衡增长路径上的经济增长动态取决于偏好参数、折旧率以及机器人和传统资本在生产与投资决策中的替代程度。
AI.theory_contributions: 为关于自动化经济后果的辩论提供理论框架，揭示决定传统资本与机器人资本积累的基础力量如何塑造未来经济形态。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供在自动化经济中优化资本分配决策的理论依据，帮助理解不同资本替代性假设下的长期增长前景。

title:
Teleology Reversed

Cause, Story, and the Shape of Human Error
affiliations: Independent

detail.title:
Teleology Reversed

Cause, Story, and the Shape of Human Error
detail.abstract:
This essay argues that intention is a teleological construct: a projection of purpose onto behavior born from first-person awareness of willing. It is not an ontic primitive but an epistemic shorthand that redescribes causal histories from the vantage of an anticipated end, it belongs to our explanatory stance, not to the fabric of being. A single structural feature of human consciousness - the asymmetry between vivid awareness of will and relative ignorance of its causes - underlies a wide family of distortions: religious teleology, ideological fanaticism, self-deception, and our chronic misreading of other people’s words. Because we feel intention from the inside and do not see its genealogy, we project purpose onto world, self, institutions, and history. Teleology in this sense is not a harmless metaphor, it is a systematic time-reversal error in explanation. It treats downstream functions as upstream intentions, and then builds entire moral and political scripts on that inversion.

Drawing on classical rationalist insights (Spinoza, Leibniz) and contemporary work in cognitive science, social theory, and the philosophy of language, I develop four linked theses. First, teleological perception is a natural default of consciousness and language, not a local superstition. Second, religion and religion-like systems (nationalisms, party ideologies, brand cults) are late-stage packages that stabilize pre-existing teleological habits, they are amplifiers, not generators. Third, our self-understanding and interpersonal speech are shaped by the same bias: we mistake the comfort of a narrative for knowledge of cause, and search for “true intention” where only causal webs exist. Finally, I outline an alternative: a life and a polity ordered by cause before story - the principle that every phenomenon, including belief, must be understood through sufficient causes before we elevate it to meaning or purpose. This is not a call to abolish meaning, but to relocate it: from first cause to human result. On this basis, reason becomes not cold detachment but the disciplined practice of re-aligning explanation with time.

AI.tldr: 本文认为意图是一种目的论建构，源于第一人称意志意识对行为的目的投射。它不是本体论原语，而是从预期结果角度重新描述因果历史的认识论简写。人类意识的不对称性（对意志的生动意识与对其原因的相对无知）导致了宗教目的论、意识形态狂热、自我欺骗等系统性扭曲。作者提出'因果先于故事'的原则，主张在赋予意义之前必须通过充分原因理解现象。
AI.research_question: 意图的本质是什么？人类意识中的意图感知如何导致系统性解释错误？
AI.motivation: 理解意图作为目的论建构的认知基础，以及这种建构如何影响我们对自我、他人、制度和历史的解释方式，从而揭示宗教、意识形态等系统性扭曲的根源。
AI.theoretical_framework: 结合古典理性主义（斯宾诺莎、莱布尼茨）和当代认知科学、社会理论、语言哲学，提出意图作为目的论建构的理论框架。
AI.method: 理论分析和概念建构，通过哲学思辨和跨学科理论整合来发展四个相互关联的命题。
AI.findings: 1. 目的论感知是意识和语言的天然默认模式；2. 宗教和类宗教系统是既有目的论习惯的稳定器；3. 自我理解和人际交流受同一偏见影响；4. 提出'因果先于故事'的替代原则。
AI.theory_contributions: 重新概念化意图作为目的论建构而非本体论实体，揭示意图感知的认知机制及其导致的系统性解释错误，为理解宗教、意识形态等现象提供新的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出'因果先于故事'的生活和政治组织原则，帮助人们避免目的论解释陷阱，促进更准确的原因理解和意义建构。

title: Synthetic Media in Modern Banking: Accountability, Governance and Consumer Protection in the Age of Digital Fraud
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Synthetic Media in Modern Banking: Accountability, Governance and Consumer Protection in the Age of Digital Fraud
detail.abstract: The emergence of artificial intelligence (AI)-generated or manipulated content, such as voice cloning, generative text, and deepfakes, has revolutionized digital communications and the financial services industry. AI technologies improve productivity, automate decision-making, and increase accessibility in contemporary banking. However, they also create previously unheard-of opportunities for financial fraud, identity theft, and deceit. With an emphasis on accountability, governance, and consumer protection, this paper examines the legal and regulatory ramifications of AI-enabled fraud in financial institutions. It looks at the dual aspect of liability: is the bank, the consumer, the technology provider, or the regulator accountable when synthetic media makes fraud easier? Drawing on Nigerian and foreign frameworks, the paper evaluates the effectiveness of laws like Nigeria's Cybercrimes (Prohibition, Prevention, etc.) by using frameworks from both Nigeria and other countries, the consumer protection guidelines of the Central Bank of Nigeria (CBN), and comparative tools such as the EU AI Act 2024, the operational resilience strategy of the UK Financial Conduct Authority (FCA), and the Federal Trade Commission (FTC) guidelines on AI impersonation in the United States. In order to address synthetic media risks in banking, the paper's conclusion suggests an integrated accountability model that unifies digital governance, fortifies consumer protection, and fosters international collaboration.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨AI生成内容在金融服务中的法律监管问题，重点关注AI欺诈的责任归属、监管框架和消费者保护，提出整合问责模型以应对合成媒体风险。
AI.research_question: 当合成媒体助长金融欺诈时，银行、消费者、技术提供商或监管机构中谁应承担责任？
AI.motivation: AI技术虽然提升了银行业效率和可及性，但也创造了前所未有的金融欺诈、身份盗窃和欺骗机会，需要明确法律责任和监管框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于责任分配理论、数字治理理论和消费者保护理论，结合尼日利亚和国际监管框架进行分析。
AI.method: 采用比较法分析，评估尼日利亚《网络犯罪法》、央行消费者保护指南，并与欧盟AI法案、英国FCA运营韧性策略、美国FTC AI冒充指南进行比较。
AI.findings: 现有法律框架在应对AI欺诈时存在责任归属不明确、监管滞后等问题，需要更完善的问责机制。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了整合问责模型，统一数字治理、强化消费者保护和促进国际合作的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为金融机构、监管机构和政策制定者提供了应对AI欺诈的具体建议和操作指南，促进更有效的风险管理。

title: The Double Burden: The Impact of School Closures on Labor Force Participation of Mothers
affiliations: University of Wuppertal

detail.title: The Double Burden: The Impact of School Closures on Labor Force Participation of Mothers
detail.abstract: This paper examines the impact of school closures on the labor supply of women with school-aged children in Mexico during the COVID-19 pandemic. Based on a DiD approach that uses women with nursery-aged children as a control group, I find that school closures led to a 3% decrease in labor force participation and employment, along with a half-an-hour reduction in weekly working hours. Domestic work increases by nearly 1.3 hours. These effects are particularly pronounced for women with medium education, those in informal employment, and those working in sectors without flexible remote work options. There are differentials in the labor supply of single mothers and no differentials for mothers with access to informal childcare. Importantly, women’s labor force participation returns to pre-closure levels once schools re-open.

AI.tldr: 本文研究发现，在墨西哥COVID-19疫情期间，学校关闭导致有学龄儿童女性的劳动力参与率和就业率下降3%，每周工作时间减少半小时，家务劳动时间增加1.3小时。这些影响对中等教育程度、非正规就业和无法远程工作的女性尤为明显。
AI.research_question: 学校关闭对有学龄儿童女性的劳动力供给有何影响？
AI.motivation: COVID-19疫情期间学校关闭可能对女性劳动力供给产生显著影响，特别是在墨西哥这样的发展中国家。
AI.theoretical_framework: 双重差分方法，使用有幼儿园年龄儿童女性作为对照组。
AI.method: 基于DiD方法的实证分析，比较有学龄儿童和有幼儿园年龄儿童女性的劳动力供给变化。
AI.findings: 学校关闭导致女性劳动力参与率和就业率下降3%，每周工作时间减少半小时，家务劳动时间增加1.3小时。影响对中等教育程度、非正规就业和无法远程工作的女性更显著。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了发展中国家背景下学校关闭对女性劳动力供给影响的实证证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者设计支持女性就业的政策提供依据，特别是在危机期间的教育和托儿服务安排方面。
